Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. After working in teams all season, the designers are relieved when they receive the news that they will now be working on their own. However, some of the eliminated designers return to act as assistants and help the competitors complete their look. For this challenge, the designers must make a Spring 2013 editorial look to be worn by actress Jordana Brewster and featured in Marie Claire.

The remaining designers are paired with new assistants and each sent to a European fashion capital: Paris, Barcelona, London, and Berlin. One unlucky designer stays in NYC. The designers must draw inspiration from their city, as well as purchase their materials there. Upon returning to NYC, they must create a look for the judges that will prove they have what it takes to design a collection for Fashion Week.

Weak and weary from their journey, the few designers left say goodbye to NYC and return to their respective hometowns to begin working on their final collections. Tim Gunn travels to visit the designers and assess their progress. In the end, all four remaining designers must present their three best pieces to the judging panel, as the judges are left to decide who will move on to show at Mercedes Benz Fashion Week.

It's the moment of truth for the remaining designers as they each present their final collections to an eager audience at Mercedes Benz Fashion Week. One designer is named the winner of Project Runway Season 11, and the rest are unfortunately out.

All of the designers get to meet with each other one more time to talk about their experiences while on Project Runway Season 11. The designers seize the opportunity to celebrate the winner and iron out any issues that may need resolving. While their discussion gets heated at times, their time together is revealing and cathartic for everybody.

Unable to bring herself to shatter Euldam's vessel, Jeongi trembles before Gangcheon until Gwanghae arrives to intervene. Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.
A film capturing a journey across Korea, collecting the diverse sounds of everyday life and bringing them together to create a single piece of music.

Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

The lives of various characters intersect at Harlem's renowned Cotton Club. Handsome horn player Dix Dwyer falls for Vera Cicero, the stunning girlfriend of famous gangster Dutch Schultz. Meanwhile, Dix's brother, Vincent, falls in with Schultz's crew, while Owney Madden, the jazz venue's proprietor, has his own mob ties. Although Dix goes on to become a Hollywood actor, his life doesn't get any less complicated or dangerous.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors, and Dylan escapes into the Route of Ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra, and locates the Meethus Diagram - but has no idea what it does.
A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.

Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.

Lindsey auditions to dance for a famous rapper's music video, but she later backs out after meeting with the powerful, demanding choreographer.

The happiest day of Charmaine's life is overshadowed by a rumor that won't die. Ryan decides it's time for a change at 9MAG and Don is just the one to make it.
Charmaine bounces back with a shop of her own, with London's hottest black female tattoo artist by her side. Ryan's business excels as his personal life struggles. Don and Ashley get unexpected news.

Dutchess faces a difficult decision when caterers, guests, and key supplies fall through. After she finds out her tattoo equipment was thrown out, Donna shows up unannounced in North Carolina to confront Dutchess and Ceaser.

Concerned that Dutchess is manipulating Ceaser, Caesar's mom tries to derail their marriage. Sky takes her new body out for a test drive. After becoming suspicious, Donna confronts Max's ex and gets an earful of information.

Sky is forced to make a life-altering decision. Puma's celebration turns ugly when Alexis confronts Donna about her past. When O'Sh*t blows off a client, Ceaser reaches his breaking point. Rah Ali shows up to Black Ink.

The crew heads north for some snow-tubing fun. O'Sh*t gets a grim warning from his doctor. Donna must make a decision about Max. Ceaser celebrates the new shop and O'Sh*t makes a decision that will change Black Ink forever.

Ceaser ushers in a new era of Black Ink at his new shop on 125th Street while Teddy takes the reins of 113th as the new executive manager. Donna finds out that her husband Max is still involved with his ex.

O'Sh*t returns to Harlem with a new name and a new flame. Ted transforms Ceaser's old office into a Boom Boom Room and hires a new tattoo artist with a questionable past. Ceaser's brand ambassador Kitty incites a brawl when she insults the 113th shop.

Ceaser is forced to confront his employees after learning that Kitty was jumped. A rumor sends Young Bae into attack mode while Nikki finally agrees to let Richard work at 113th. Sky concocts a crazy plan to get Donna back at the shop.

Dutchess takes over 113th and plans a 24-hour tattoo-a-thon to save the shop, but a fight between Sky and Tiffany threatens to ruin the entire event. An urgent call from Richard has Nikki racing to the Bronx courthouse.

Sky ends up with stitches when Tiffany confronts her about her attitude. Melody wants to return to Black Ink. Sky shares a closely guarded secret with Ceaser. Richard and Nikki's wedding celebration turns ugly.
Walt tries to convince Richard to take care of his legal situation. Ceaser is shocked when Donna shows up at the shop wanting her job back. Dutchess comes home to NYC to celebrate her magazine cover.

programmes.st: The Ring Didn't Mean A Thing
programmes.d: Ceaser is shocked when Dutchess leaves him. Sky asks her female co-workers for a very personal favor. Walt and Sky introduce Young Bae to online dating. Sky fears for her safety when a man from her past shows up at the shop.

The crew takes Ceaser to Miami for some sun, sand, and senoritas. Richard battles it out in court with Kathie over custody of their son. Dutchess receives a disturbing phone call that has her questioning her decision to leave NYC

The crew heads out on a camping trip for some team-building exercises but all hell breaks loose when an unexpected visitor arrives. Dutchess demands proof of Ceaser's affair. Sky and Donna discover dark secrets from Nikki's past

The crew tries to persuade Ceaser to reopen the shop. Dutchess returns to New York and makes a shocking discovery on Ceaser's computer. A Friendsgiving celebration turns sour when Sky attacks Teddy about his behavior.

As the crew heads to Puerto Rico, a massive screw-up from Teddy threatens to derail the entire trip. Melody loses her cool when Lalo refuses to make the ultimate commitment. Ceaser and Dutchess finally come face to face.

Danny and Jackie set out to investigate the murder of a bride on her wedding day in a drive-by gang shooting.
When Erin's key witness, an infamous photographer, is nearly killed in a hit and run, she arranges for Danny to work protection detail to safeguard him.

Shortly after Frank awards a detective with the Medal of Valor for his undercover work for the NYPD in Malaysia, the detective is taken hostage by a Malaysian drug lord whose brother he helped put in prison.
When a knife-wielding attacker dressed as Baron Samedi, the Spirit of Death, stabs a man in costume on Halloween, Danny enters the world of voodoo.
Danny arrives at a college campus to find a murdered student, who was thought to be dealing drugs.
When two motorists driving gas-guzzling cars die at the hands of a sniper, Danny and Kate are put on the case of what the city believes is the work of a radical environmental serial killer.
When Danny and Kate come up empty-handed with leads for a shooting, Linda helps make a break in the case when she overhears the victim telling his priest who is responsible.
Jamie must deal with the emotional consequences of his actions on the job.
When Danny's car matches an NYPD description of a vehicle involved in a drug deal, he is stopped and taken into custody when a bag of cocaine is found in his trunk.
When a man with multiple rat bites is thrown from a moving car, Danny works the case to find out why and who was trying to send a message.

Before a Hasidic Grand Rebbe passes away, he chooses his youngest son to succeed him. But when the new appointee dies suddenly, Danny investigates the oldest son and others within the Hasidic community.
When a 10-year-old boy is the victim of an incident in the projects, Danny's heated approach to the case lands him in anger management class.
Erin and Danny investigate a cold case of a girl who was attacked by her rich and powerful boyfriend, who was never convicted.
When an off-duty cop tries to stop a bank robbery, he is disarmed by the 'Bonnie and Clyde' robbers who take his gun and wound an innocent bystander.
When the same tragedy occurs to people who don't appear connected, Danny must find what they have in common and who is responsible.
When a religious young woman is murdered, Danny questions her family who is shocked to learn that she had a secret relationship.
When two Wall Street brokers are killed in drug deals, Danny looks to question a wounded accomplice at the hospital but he is stopped by Linda, who won't let Danny see him until after surgery.
Hoss finds a kindred spirit in Skeeter Dexter, a lonesome young man who feels closer to animals than most people.
After inadvertantly falling into the river, Adam is rescued by Tom Wilson.  Wilson has feelings for Sue Miller, which bring him into trouble after her father is killed.
Hoss and a pair of nuns, the younger one having a difficult time training for the order, are robbed and stranded at a way station.
After sitting on a jury that has convicted Terrence O' Tool of murder, Joe has second thoughts about the verdict and decides to do some investigating of his own.
A man who looks similar to Joe uses Joe's name and gets Joe in the position of facing the firing squad.
Ladies' man Lothario Larkin creates havoc whenever he hits Virginia City, so Roy Coffee orders him out of town.  Naturally, Hoss takes him in.
Adam and Laura are finally engaged.  Adam is secretly building a house and planning for the future. Laura realizes that it's Will she is in love with.
When a Italian immigrant comes to the Ponderosa, he decides he wants to give up the guitar to become a cowboy.
Joe is bushwhacked in the desert and awakens to find himself in Martinville, a town that may or may not be populated by ghosts.  An eerie, surrealistic and well-produced episode.
Mary Wharton, an old friend of the family, comes to live on the Ponderosa with her shiftless husband.  When Ben learns Mary is the victim of domestic abuse, he sends Russ packing.
A sailor, claiming to be one of Adam's closest friends, is given a warm welcome by the Cartwrights, who have no way of knowing the man and his accomplice plan on robbing them.
When mountain man Jim Leyton decides to marry, he chooses Hoss as his best man.  Julie's father, Grizzly, does not agree and Hoss must come to the rescue.

On their way to prevent a young woman from encountering the renegade Indians, Joe and Tuck are captured, and in order to save them all, Joe must fight Sharp Tongue, who is the leader of the band who went to school with Joe as a youth.
While talking with an Indian, Ben is given an unexpected present... a woman.  She is a young white woman named Joan who has lived with the Indians since she was a little girl.
Ben helps Matthew Raine, a famous painter who has gone blind and now wallows in self-pity, discover a new purpose in life.  However, Raine's employee Gavin has other ideas.

Renowned English novelist Charles Dickens comes to Virginia City. In short order, he is accused of a crime he didn't commit. The problem then becomes how to convince the stubborn author to defend himself.
Claude Miller, the laughingstock of Virginia City, gets even with everyone who made fun of him when he strikes it rich.
Iwabe, Denki and Metal pay a visit to Boruto after he lands in the hospital from overtraining.

programmes.st: The Secret Behind the Underground Room
programmes.d: Konohamaru and Mugino receive intel that the Feudal Lord of the Land of Valleys will be touring the company, giving them the opportunity to check the inner reaches of the secretive facility.

programmes.st: The Revival of the Divine Tree
programmes.d: Boruto and Sarada rush to Victor's research lab where they find a horrifying plant stealing the chakra of the people near it
Separated from Boruto and Sarada, Konohamaru battles Victor. But someone unexpected shows up to fight alongside him.

Konohamaru and his teammates report their findings that the Kara receives outside assistance from people called Outers, and that these Outers may have covertly infiltrated the Five Great Shinobi Nations.
The Yamanaka Clan, who have been tracking the village’s ingoing and outgoing traffic with their advanced sensory abilities, spearheads a plan to create a new sensory system.
A memorial service is being held in remembrance of the many fallen from the Fourth Great Ninja War.
The mysterious organization known as the Kara is about to take one of their plans to the next stage that involves a crucial item called a “Vessel.”
Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki are assigned to carry out Team 7’s missions by themselves until Konohamaru returns from an unexpected assignment.
The airship transporting Kara’s Vessel has gone missing, and the Inners call an emergency meeting.
Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and transport a Scientific Ninja Tool. Stuck on a mission he doesn’t like, Boruto runs into Ao while aboard the Thunder Train headed to their destination.
Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development, and is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.
Team 7, along with Katasuke and Chamaru, the Ninja Hound, go to the location where Konohamaru and Mugino's communications cut out and they are attacked by mysterious puppets.
After allowing Boruto and the others to escape, Ao is visited by Koji Kashin.
Team 7 works together to launch a barrage of attacks, but countering Ao’s adept use of Scientific Ninja Tools will not be easy. Just as they seem to have cornered him, Ao reveals his greatest weapon.
As Boruto and his friends finish their battle with Ao, Koji Kashin, a member of Kara, appears!
On their way back to the village, the team discovers an unconscious boy who has the same strange mark on his palm as Boruto.
The battle between Garo—an Outer—and Kawaki—also known as the Vessel—begins!
The team returns to the Advanced Technology Lab with Kawaki. Konohamaru has returned to the village to report on the mission.
Kawaki escapes the Advanced Technology Lab and finds himself in a bustling shopping district. Exhausted and hungry, he desperately searches for food.
Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.

At the same time that the Avatars are planning to transform the world into their envisioned utopia, Zankou kidnaps Brody and is forced to cast a paranoia spell on the Halliwell sisters.
Leo discovers that the Charmed Ones' conflict-free world comes with a higher price than anticipated, so he must join Zankou to stop the Avatars and reverse the change.
When Paige tries to hire a new professor for the Magic School, one of the candidates, Drake, turns out to be an ex-demon who made a deal with a sorcerer to become human.
When Daryl's friend is possessed by the spirit of an innocent killed in a fire in 1899, Phoebe and Drake transport themselves back in time to the cabaret where it happened.
Piper is attacked by demons and winds up in a coma, and as she hovers between life and death, her spirit meets a familiar face who wants to help restore Phoebe's faith in love.
In an attempt to lure the sisters out of the manor, Zankou sends his underlings to attack Leo, in order for him to search the house for the Nexus and release the Shadow, the ultimate power.

The sisters scramble to recover Pandora's Box when it falls into the hands of a shapeshifting demon who intends to open it and fill the world with all of its sorrows. Meanwhile, Paige's Whitelighter side rises to the surface.
A powerful sorceress switches bodies with Phoebe, who ends up trapped in the Underworld. Meanwhile, Paige faces a big problem when her new charge refuses her help.

Unbeknownst to the sisters, baby Wyatt's new 'imaginary' friend is actually a demon named Vicus who is trying to win Wyatt's trust to turn him evil. Meanwhile, Piper casts a spell to be able to understand baby Wyatt.
When a person who was killed right in front of Phoebe comes back from the dead to blame her, she becomes guilt-ridden and vulnerable, creating an opportunity for Zankou to steal the Book of Shadows.

When the sisters try to divert Zankou's attention from the Nexus, he hatches a plan to absorb all their powers. However, when the girls realize what Zankou is up to, they are faced with a life-altering decision: sacrifice their powers or their lives.
After being presumed dead, the Halliwell sisters begin their demon-free existence with new identities.
While attempting to take over the Underworld, a young demon plots to lure the Charmed Ones out of hiding, but when Billie stumbles onto his plot ,she becomes one of his victims instead.
When Piper goes for a job interview with a corporate recruiter, she's shocked to learn that the background check of her assumed identity was that of a woman wanted for murder.

Wyatt's school play brings out the competitive nature in Piper when her hand-sewn costume & parenting abilities are criticized by another mother. However things go from bad to worse, because this Stepford-like mother is actually a demon in disguise.

Billie jeopardizes the Charmed Ones' new lives when Agent Murphy spots her using her powers to save an innocent. Meanwhile, Phoebe's overnight trip with Dex comes to a surprising conclusion when Billie casts a spell to make her happy.

Billie must deal with her painful childhood memories of her sister's kidnapping, before she can vanquish her latest demon target, The Dogan. Meanwhile, the press are bombarding the sisters, since the announcement of their teaming with Homeland Security.

A family transforms one of the oldest existing homes in the United States.
A man, along with his wife and kids, restores his historic family home.
Christina Salway and John Moskowitz restore a farmhouse on the Maine coast.

A mother-daughter design team restore a home on Maryland's eastern shore.
An iconic 1905 Louisiana home filled with secrets comes back to life.
The Vanoven family restores a small town's crown jewel to its former glory.
Husband and wife renovators restore an 1800s farmhouse in New Orleans.
Bogart plays an escaped con who has nothing to lose. March is a suburban Everyman who has everything to lose - his family is held hostage by Bogart.

programmes.t: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
programmes.d: Oscar® nominee Richard Burton* is the burnt-out British agent who refuses to “come in from the cold” to take a desk job.
After taking the rap for his partner, a mobster is released from prison to find his former partner entranched in a swank night club with no intention of sharing the riches.

A cave collapse traps a man, and all eyes turn toward the tragedy, including those of Charles "Chuck" Tatum (Kirk Douglas), a washed-up newspaper reporter who sees the incident as a ticket back to his former days at the top of the journalism heap.
This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.
Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.
An unwilling Maude reluctantly agrees to go on a game show with Vivian, only to have her attempts at keeping Vivian from making a fool of herself backfire.

The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.
Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.
The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.

It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.
In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.

In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.

Lecherous Louie, the dispatcher, becomes a lovesick pup after his girlfriend finds another guy. He will stop at nothing to get her back, including recruiting Alex for his hilarious scheme—and the riotous shenanigans at the Sunshine Cab Co. never stop.

It’s a riotous family reunion when Jim returns home to face his millionaire dad for the first time since he dropped out of society in the ‘60s, and Alex has his hands full with Jim’s voluptuous, overly amorous sister,

The Taxi gang falls prey to hilarious fear for homeless Elaine’s romantic well-being when chivalrous Bobby allows her to live in his apartment while he is gone. Unexpectedly, he returns before she has found other quarters
Hilarious sparks fly when Tony tries to fix up his divorced sister with Alex.  Instead, she ends up falling for Reverend Jim and Tony goes outrageously overboard trying to break up the affair.

Lecherous Louie the dispatcher has the dubious honor of being selected by his employer’s revenge-seeking wife to be her clandestine lover, and comedic panic grips the love lair when the boss shows up unexpectedly.
Wild and crazy theatrics erupt when Tony decides to become an actor and Bobby, as his skeptical agent, is aghast when Tony lands a role because he is the right type.

Bobby’s vicious letter to a hated critic is salvaged from the wastebasket and sent to the newspaper by a gleeful Louie, setting the stage for a wild and comical night when the critic, and the cabbies, decide to take in Bobby’s one-man play.

When Latka Gravas is rejected by a young beauty, he sets out on an uproarious crash course to learn to be a swinging American Bachelor, a turnabout that works fantastically with the girls but turns off all of his friends at the garage.
Jim turns into a soothsayer when he warns of a bizarre catastrophe to befall Alex that also involves an affair with a beautiful blonde.

The taxi gang hits the bricks in a hilarious hunt for new jobs when the Sunshine Cab. Co. goes out of business, with the promise that they will meet at Mario’s in one month to review their experiences.
The cabbies discover that life on the outside is not so rosy when the Sunshine Cab Co. shuts down. They all end up hilariously assuming new careers.

Louie turns into a jealous romantic when his overtures to accompany Elaine on her European vacation are rejected. Instead, Alex becomes the pretty cabbie's holiday companion on a tour of Europe's hot spots—culminating in a romantic rendezvous.

Riotous confusion prevails when Latka Gravas' split personalities prompt Elaine and Alex to take him to a psychiatrist's office, where the predicament takes on a wild new twist as Latka takes on Alex's personality.
Cabbie Jim Ignatowski's legendary psychic powers hilariously thrust him into the hectic world of television programming when he predicts that a TV show will be a hit.
Using the German propaganda radio network,Hogan gets information to the underground.

programmes.st: What Time Does the Balloon Go Up?
programmes.d: Hogan helps an escapee go out of camp in a balloon.

programmes.st: LeBeau and the Little Old Lady
programmes.d: LeBeau says that he keeps rendezvousing with a little old lady who is actually young and beautiful.

programmes.st: How to Escape from Prison Camp Without Really Trying
programmes.d: Hogan has trouble trying to get thirty prisoners out of camp.
A collection of stolen art comes to Stalag 13 and Hogan decides to steal it back for the Allies.
Hogan makes the Germans think that Schultz has ESP to get them to move their anti-aircraft defenses.

programmes.st: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programmes.d: Lisa's 'Mudder' pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.
Peggy and her son are held hostage by men who want the evidence that Mannix has, that proves his detective friend was murdered.
A controversial television interviewer telephones a shadowy figure named Harry Armitage for the "hot seat" segment of his show, accusing Armitage of bribery and influence peddling.
A young woman who has entered a county fair competition in a rural community north of Los Angeles disappears, and her wealthy father hires Joe Mannix to look for her.
Mannix helps his carnival owner friend find out if any of the workers are causing accidents that might be attempts on her life.
While Barnaby and J.R. are tied up working on another case, Betty takes a part in a stage production as a singer and dancer to find out who's terrorizing its cast members.
J.R. gets involved in a dangerous situation when an old friend tells him that her ex-husband is stalking her and their son and using his influence as a police officer to do it.
Betty goes under hypnosis so she can remember the events that led up to a car accident that killed her friend and caused her to lose her memory-and realizes it was no accident.
In the course of investigating the death of a film editor, Barnaby and J.R. uncover a movie pirating operation that could potentially cost the studio millions in lost revenue.
A Japanese female terrorist, with American scientists, kidnaps industrialist's son & demands $1.5m ransom. Five-O team races to save boy held in capsule with 52hr air supply before suffocating.

programmes.st: Love Thy Neighbor - Take his Wife
programmes.d: Steve McGarrett and Five-O are on a mission to find the kidnapper of a wealthy land developer's wife. Despite evidence pointing to militant ecologist Ben Tanaka, McGarrett has doubts and continues to investigate to uncover the true culprit.

Trying to identify and bag the burglars who have been heisting a fortune in gold stored
at various dental-supply warehouses, McGarrett sends an undercover agent into a
rehabilitation institution for delinquent youths in hopes of securing a lead.

Operating with daring, and virtually under the nose of Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett, Hawaiian history museum curator Arthur Lambert secretly plots to turn criminal and stage the biggest bank robbery in Island annals.

Honolulu prostitutes are being murdered, and those who have not been are living in terror. McGarrett feels sure the murderer's game is extortion — a demand accompanied by a death threat which is carried out if the demand is not met.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: A drug dealer flees the scene after he runs over a young boy. When the offender is arrested, Chief Gillespie is determined to see him stand trial, but the Feds offer him a deal that will set him free if he testifies against a powerful drug lord.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Love is in the air when Lieutenant Bubba Skinner rekindles a romance with his high school sweetheart, the newly-widowed Christine Millings. To Bubba's surprise, her attorney is murdered and she's suddenly looking like the prime suspect.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: While fishing on his day off, Bubba Skinner's dog unearths a dead baby. The investigation leads to a mentally-challenged girl and her family who’s not interested in talking. Will they get past the family’s secrets to learn the truth about the baby?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Having served his time, Prosper Hoag is on parole and back home in Sparta. The folks in town will never forget the accident he caused that resulted in the death of three children and permanent injuries to two others, but will they forgive him?
It's a case of mistaken identity when Greg, a mobster who looks just like Mark, is released from prison and moves into Mark's neighborhood.
Jesse operates and removed the bullet from Greg, thinking he is Mark. But everything starts to unfold when mark show up for his shift at the hospital.
Mark's patient and shock-jock radio talk show host Denise announces her nation-wide search for her birth mother and jokes that she'll kill her if she doesn't want anything to do with her.
A (black) preacher who's a friend of Trent's dad is being targeted by a racist whom he helped send to prison.
Joe Lopez is a paroled convict wanting to stay clean and mend his relationship with his family. Unfortunately, he is being pressured to use his safecracking skills to help a gang pull a job.

Drug dealers are being more active and brazen trying to sell their drugs. They target a high school and a teacher is killed when he tries to run the dealers off school grounds. The students decide they must take back their school.

A relative of Carlos Sandoval is falsely arrested for a crime and sent to prison. Alex and Walker prove his innocence, but before Hector is released, he witnesses a guard kill another prisoner who wants to blow the whistle on wrong-doing.
John McIntire guest stars as a migrant farm worker with whom Richard Kimble is working when he is tracked down and captured by Lt. Gerard.
Richard Kimble becomes chauffeur in the strange household of a teenage violin virtuoso.
Richard Kimble stumbles into the intrigues of a politically ambitious man when he rescues a leading citizen and his woman companion from a plane crash.
Nikki unknowingly becomes the target of an international terrorist group, planning to detonate bombs across the city in exchange for the release of their recently imprisoned leader.
MacGyver battles an eccentric scientist whose bizarre biological experiments go out of control and threaten the environment.
After an accident forces Pete Thornton to retire from the foundation, MacGyver suspects foul play within the organization and uncovers a plot to assassinate a visiting Third World Leader.
A woman is murdered during the burglary of her opulent Malibu home, a burglary in which a rare diamond, part of a set of famous Russian jewels known as The Seven Deadly Sins, is stolen.
As preparations for the hospital's Christamas party swing into high gear, Claude, a popular hospital maintenance man, who each year portrays Santa Claus at the big bash, collapses.

Dr. Mark Sloan finds himself needing a vacation from his vacation when his plans for a relaxing trip abroad a cruise liner as a doctor is turned upside down as a family finds their father has been murdered.
Mark and Amanda have brough their kids to the set of Frontier Dad, a popular western TV series, to watch the filming of an action sequence.
Mr. Wilson is named chairman of a saving-stamps campaign for the Junior Astronauts and arranges a contest at Dennis' school to win a trip to Cape Canaveral to meet an astronaut.
Mr. Wilson tells Dennis he isn't feeling well just to get Dennis to leave him alone, but Dennis of course spreads the word and leads everyone to believe that Mr. Wilson is very sick.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Margaret Learns To Drive
programmes.d: Jim teaches Margaret how to drive, but they end up in a fight.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Way Of A Dictator
programmes.d: After learning about dictators in school, Bud takes over raising Kathy.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Mr. Beal Meets His Match
programmes.d: Jim sells his soul to the devil -- at least, in Betty's version of the Faustian legend.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Kathy Makes A Wish
programmes.d: Kathy makes a wish on a horseshoe, and it comes true.
When Buffy has an operation to remove her tonsils, Jody complains of a sore throat, too. Uncle Bill and French think he's simply looking for attention until the doctor looks at them.

Cissy is taking an art class and has been drawing caricature images of the family members, but does not mention one for Mr. French. He is hurt at being left out, however, Cissy has his picture and wants to surprise him with it.

Uncle Bill and Mr. French attend Buffy and Jody's open night at school to view their latest art and work. At school, Bill meets another single parent with two young children and one teenager. Bill starts dating her and thinking of a family merger.

A boy at school likes Buffy but does not talk to her. Cissy thinks the boys do not like her because there is something wrong with her, so Uncle Bill pays to have different people coach her in dress, makeup, talking, walking, and more.
Bobby becomes obsessed with Jesse James. Mike and Carol don't approve of his new hero, and try to find a way to convince him that James was nothing but a "mean, dirty killer."
Marcia breaks a date with Charlie when "big man on campus" Doug Simpson asks her out. However, after she gets hit in the nose with a football, Doug Simpson breaks his date with her.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.

Cindy loses her mom's earrings after playing with them, and "detective" Peter Brady tries to solve the mystery. But when Carol wants the earrings for a costume ball and they're still not found, the entire family tries to crack the case.
The Brady girls try to play matchmaker between Carol's free-spirited grandmother and stick-in-the-mud Grandpa Brady.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.

Mike and Lionel are planning on attending a demonstration at the United Nations. However, the rally gets out of hand and news of it appears on TV. This worries Gloria who begs Archie to go down there and get Mike.

A local election has the Bunker family in turmoil as Mike and Gloria are all for Claire Packer, a woman, which is why Archie is dead set against her. However, once down at the voting booths, Archie realizes that he can't vote because he isn't registered.

At the grocery store, Edith has an accident in the parking lot. She loses control of her shopping cart which smashes into a car and a can of Cling Peaches (in heavy syrup) flies out of the cart, onto the car, and makes a dent.

Mike is all stressed out with upcoming exams leaving him impotent and frustrated. Gloria encourages him to discuss it with her, but he refuses. Gloria confides in Edith what the problem is, and in turn she tells Archie.

The Bunkers are having problems with their furnace which gets Archie entertaining the idea of moving. When an unscrupulous black real-estate salesman, Mr. Byrd, offers Archie a hefty sum of money for his home, Archie is all for it despite Mike's warnings.

Archie comes home from work in a particularly awful mood because he has to make an important decision at work. His decision to lay off a Puerto Rican leads to an interesting visit to the Bunker household.

It's Christmas Day and Archie is the only one not in the Christmas spirit. Mike and Gloria question him, but he refuses to reveal what's bugging him. The Jeffersons come over to wish the Bunkers a 'Merry Christmas'.

Archie comes home from work in a great mood and orders Edith to have dinner ready and waiting, because he has to watch the CBS Evening News to see himself on it. Archie was interviewed as a man-on-the-street voicing his opinions on Nixon's presidency.

programmes.st: There is Nothing Like the Dames
programmes.d: Things quickly go from bad to worse when Mama hosts a backyard luncheon for a ladies' social group she wants to join, and the ladies leave in a huff.
In the series finale, Vint and Naomi finally have a baby and Mama becomes a grandmother—but not before high drama.

programmes.st: Vint and the Kids Move In
programmes.d: Mama's son Vint and his two children stop by to do some laundry. But while there, Vint ends up revealing that he has gotten evicted and they need a place to stay. Mama tells them they can move in with her.

Naomi comes over and announces that she has sold her home and is going to move away. After drinking and celebrating, they return to Mama's, and Naomi ends up spending the night. Vint ends up asking Naomi to marry him.
Naomi and Vint's wedding is coming up.  While the women are having a little party, Ellen is worried that her husband Bruce is having an affair, and the family tries to tell her that he is not.

The day of the wedding has come, and Mama is under a lot of stress trying to clean the house for the ceremony. She gives Vint her late husband's sapphire ring and tells him to not let Eunice know because she wants it.

Vint tells the family about his plan on taking Mama, Ellen, Naomi, and Buzz with him to play Family Feud. Mama is against going, but Vint tells her they need her because she is an important factor, being the "sweet old lady."

Eunice is given a surprise birthday party at the Bigger Jigger. The party soon takes a nasty turn, and Mama and Eunice get into a fight. They get arrested after accidentally hitting two police officers and have to share a cell.
Though Mama doesn't have experience, she lands a job as a receptionist. She is fired because of constant distractions from her family whose problems she solves quickly once she returns home.

programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programmes.t: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programmes.d: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programmes.t: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programmes.d: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.
Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.
By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.
Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.
Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programmes.d: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programmes.st: The Widow And The Wolf/Texas Drifter
programmes.d: After the murder of her aunt goes cold, a woman helps launch an advocate group that brings awareness to cases that have gone unsolved.

A high school janitor is suspected in the murder of a young girl, but with only circumstantial evidence to go on, police must let the case go cold. And a woman asks the police to reopen the 24-year-old case of her cousin's disappearance.

From England to Texas to Georgia, I.R. will go inside cold case units and watch as police use ballistics testing, old fashioned fingerprints and a new DNA data bank for criminals, to crack open the mysteries of unsolved crimes.

Investigators in Virginia, probing the murder case of a sailor, seek the help of a forensic anthropologist from the "body farm" in the Great Smoky Mountains. Dr. William Bass became an expert on the human body's rate of decay by watching bodies.
A district attorney uses a clever technique--a "John Doe indictment"--to give law enforcement officials the time they need to track down the Schoolgirl Rapist from Rochester, N. Y.
In Cree culture, a promise is sacred. When Cree woman Shirley Soosay goes missing in 1980, her niece Violet promises her grandmother that she will bring Shirley home.

programmes.st: The Boy And The Monster/Secret In The Cellar
programmes.d: In Portland, Maine a housewife disappears. One year later her body is unearthed in the cellar. I.R. unravels this cold case investigation from the inside out. With the help of science, police are able to uncover a blueprint of the crime.

When a schoolteacher is found murdered in her New Jersey apartment in the fall of 2009, suspicion is cast on her soon to be ex-husband. Long after the case goes cold, a detective embarks on a mission to help the man clear his name.
When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programmes.st: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programmes.d: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.
A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programmes.st: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programmes.d: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programmes.st: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programmes.d: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Just Breve
programmes.d: Sarah narrates the story of Breve, the baby robot; Laura and Jay open up to each other about their sexual interests.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Smellin' of Troy
programmes.d: Troy, Sarah's childhood imaginary friend, returns and lures her into a life of sex and drugs. Steve's song that mocks Brian gains immense popularity.
When TelAmeriCorp starts selling more female-friendly products, the women in the office are promoted and start wielding their new power over the men.
Adam and Ders struggle to get back into the dating game, and Jillian and Blake discover that co-parenting a cat is more responsibility than they can handle.
After a special adult video the guys order goes missing, they must embark on a quest to find the package before it's too late.
When a social media expert comes to the office, the guys compete to hone their personal brands.
As 420 approaches, Blake meets a woman online, but Adam and Ders are convinced that he's being catfished.
After the guys run into a former coworker who was transferred to another branch of TelAmeriCorp, they try to get jobs there.
Jordan and Keegan engage in an epic flicker match, and a flash mob goes terribly wrong.
President Obama doesn't get special treatment, and a young Forest Whitaker terrifies his babysitter.
Two friends encounter a racist dog in the park, the flamboyant players of the East/West Collegiate Bowl introduce themselves, and a dubstep track derails moving day.
A young Barack Obama discovers how inspirational a party can be, and two hitmen get sidetracked.

Nathan markets an unappealing children's toy, devises a way to shame people who share their movie snacks and pitches a reality show starring Simon the security guard.
Nathan tries to leverage Best Buy's price-matching policy by advertising a deal on TVs that's too good to be true.
Nathan devises a way to provide a moving company with free labor.
Nathan recruits child athletes for endorsement deals and finds a way to put drunk people's clumsiness to good use.

programmes.d: A magical dragon phone causes Brian and Steve to switch bodies, and Sarah tries to inspire people with a disability she doesn't have.
When the batteries in Sarah's TV remote die, she embarks on an odyssey to find new ones; Brian and Steve discuss politics.
Sarah gets picked up on a DUI, and Brian insists that he's a bisexual.
To cure herself of the blahs, Sarah gets an AIDS test; Jay has a birthday party for the first time.
Cartman inherits a million dollars from his grandmother and fulfills his lifelong dream of owning his own amusement park: Cartmanland!
In a time-honored tradition and right-of-passage, the boys are separated from the girls and schooled in the mysteries of sex by none other than Mr. Mackey.
When the government steals their new Gamesphere, the boys will stop at nothing to get it back.

programmes.st: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
programmes.d: The kids of South Park have raised money to send to the children of Afghanistan, but the Government believes the Afghani children's thank you gift is contaminated with Anthrax and the boys are forced to take it back to Afghanistan.

programmes.st: How to Eat with Your Butt
programmes.d: Cartman gets Kenny's school picture on every "missing child" milk carton in the country.
In a very special episode of 'South Park,' Cartman fights for Kenny's life when he speaks before Congress in favor of stem-cell research.
Alone and lost, Butters determinedly makes his way through porn theatres and gay bathhouses in an effort to get his dad back home in time to eat at Bennigan's for his parents' anniversary.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Woof!  Woof!  Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies."  A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages.  To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou—a cute and cuddly forest creature—who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island.  It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs.  Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots' favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin!  It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Ping³ino all the way back home to the South Pole.
Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
It's Halloween, and Dora and Boots are out trick-or-treating when a cute monster surprises them. Dora and Boots help hurry it home before the clock strikes 12.
What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?
It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.
Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats, and even silly dancing. But, oh no!
Uh oh! Boots has a hole—un hoyo—in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!
A wandering cowboy abandons his baby boy and leaves him in Dr. Mike's care.
Progress comes to Colorado Springs, and Sully pays the price.
When Cheyenne medicine man Cloud Dancing is wounded by General Custer, who intends to hang him, Sully and Dr. Mike join forces to help him escape.
As Dr. Mike's birthday approaches, the kids decide to do something about her unmarried status
Matthew and Michaela are at odds over his future when he sets out to prove to others -- and to himself -- that he's a grown man ready to take on life -- and decides to marry Ingrid.
Influenced by the pulp romance novels she loves, Colleen develops her first crush -- on Sully -- and schemes a way for him to rescue her from danger.
Dr. Mike faces the most difficult challenge of her career when she is forced to operate on Brian after he suffers a brain injury.
Dr. Mike discovers Hank's dark secret -- an illegitimate son.
A famous civil war photographer realizes he may be taking his last picture after Dr. Mike discovers that he is going blind.
Dr. Mike breaks the rules to enter her new horse in an important race.
Dr. Mike must prove that Loren’s sister-in-law did not murder her abusive husband.
A dead man walks when Halloween comes to Colorado Springs.
Jake is accused of killing a Cheyenne brave, and the incident disrupts the town, as well as the friendship between Sully and Cloud Dancing.
Dr. Mike clashes with a traveling faith healer over a cure for Kid Cole’s tuberculosis.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
A severe drought threatens -- and divides -- Colorado Springs at Thanksgiving.
Alexis is relieved and Blake is concerned when Amanda suddenly changes her mind and decides to marry Prince Michael. Sammy Jo is revealed to be the culprit behind the compromising photographs.

Claudia flies to Mexico to divorce Steven. Unexpectedly, Adam appears at her hotel and they spend the night together. After Amanda embarrasses Prince Michael at Dominique's party, his patience is exhausted and he leaves her.

Blake and Daniel survive the plane crash. Jeff charters a helicopter and braves hazardous conditions to finally locate the wreckage. Krystle and Blake finally clear the air and renew their commitment to each other.

Krystle accompanies Daniel to New York for his reunion with Sammy Jo, the child he's never known. While looking through photos Ashley snapped on assignment at a rock concert, Jeff is stunned to spot Fallon among the crowd.

As Alexis and Amanda emerge from an exclusive bridal salon, a car suddenly screeches to a halt and Amanda is pulled inside. A high-speed chase ensues. As Dex forces the kidnapper's car onto the sidewalk, Amanda breaks free.

Dex tells a devastated Krystle that Daniel Reece is dead. Steven is outraged when Sammy Jo decides to fight for custody of her son in court. Jeff proposes marriage to Ashley. Sammy Jo learns that her monies will be held in trust with Krystle as executor.

Elena confesses to Amanda that nothing happened in the bedroom with Prince Michael. Sammy Jo fits her roommate Rita with a blonde wig and has her practice duplicating Krystle's voice. Fallon has chosen a new name and heads for Denver.

Those surviving the massacre in Moldavia are separated and held at the palace; Krystle and Alexis are imprisoned in the palace dungeon; Sammy Jo reveals her scheme to Rita; Fallon, suffering from amnesia, reacts to seeing the name Colby.

Blake secures the release of Krystle and Alexis, and the families return from Moldavia; Luke is buried; Rita's boyfriend Joel is anxious to help Sammy Jo further her scheme; Alexis is preoccupied with Galen's welfare; Fallon tells Miles she has amnesia.

Blake receives a business proposition from Jason Colby, whom he hasn't seen in 20 years; Jeff's Aunt Constance summons him to California; the State Department questions Blake; Rita undergoes plastic surgery to complete her 'Krystle Look.'

Krystle makes a surprise visit to Sammy Jo in New York; Adam follows Claudia to San Francisco; Constance awards nephew Jeff 50% of Colby Enterprises; Dominique is paid a visit by a mysterious man from her past.
Alexis learns Galen is alive in Moldavia; Jeff plans to move to California; Adam and Claudia are married; Krystle pays a surprise visit to Sammy Jo and spots her double, Rita.

Krystle is held at Delta Rho Farms while Rita impersonates her at the mansion; Dex is captured in Moldavia; The Colby family arrives in Denver to attend Blake's party; Jeff spots Fallon among the guests.
Dex orchestrates a dramatic rescue in Moldavia; Jeff discovers a clue to Fallon's whereabouts; Little Blake realizes Rita is not Krystle; Dominique places a mysterious overseas call.

After reaching safety, a paralyzed King Galen is hospitalized; Joel poses as a doctor to gain entry to the mansion; Claudia inherits an oil well; Rita drugs Blake; Galen makes Alexis a powerful promise from his hospital bed.

Sammy Jo panics at Blake's possible discovery of Krystle's captivity; Claudia plots with Adam to get her oil well back; Galen promises to make Alexis a powerful woman as he attempts to regain the throne.
A wealthy businessman disappears from a five-star hotel.
A 5-year-old boy goes missing while his grandmother baby-sits.
The team searches for an escaped convict.
The team all face psychiatric evaluation, and Jess hunts for a missing legal secretary.
At Sage's evidentiary hearings, the D.A.'s strategy is working and Sage could be tried for murder; meanwhile, things heat up between Marquise and Angel.

Sage is freed from jail and ready to reclaim the tour as headliner; the Chicago show will be Rigo's final performance, and he's under pressure to come up with new material; Poppy and Colette butt heads over Rigo.

Romantic entanglements are tearing Sage, Colette, Rigo and Poppy in new directions; the love triangle between Davis, Odalie and Angel has come to a tipping point; Tal has a new position as Sage's creative director.
Cam meets a special woman while he contends with a potential career-ending injury; Reggie's representation of Jupiter becomes an exercise in futility.
Cam plans a magical first date for Allison; Uncle Julius takes a jaunt with the police and learns how the other half lives; M-Chuck uses her therapy to heap guilt upon her mother.
Missy is recruited to tutor Jupiter when his draft status is threatened; Cam and Allison's relationship grows, along with Reggie's business ventures.
Reggie has doubts about representing Jupiter; Allison declines Cam's expensive gifts; a crisis rocks the family.
The tragic loss of a loved one leaves family members with a sudden hole in their lives.
The Calloways and the Vaughns comfort one another as they navigate their way through the most trying ritual of their lives.
Lady Mae visits world-famous Pastor Maxine Patterson and endures the Bishop's final attempt to win her back at a Round Table party; Connie asks if Grace is interested in running Calvary.
The Bishop and Lady Mae make alternate plans after Clara denies them the check for the IRS bill; Grace tends to Sophia when a medical emergency sends her daughter to the hospital.
Maxine Patterson visits Calvary during the same weekend that Lady Mae and the Bishop announce their divorce to the congregation; Grace and Rochelle find a case for their legal defense fund.

Grace questions her involvement in the Coralie Hunter case when the district attorney threatens to reopen her case with Mac; the Bishop and Lady Mae disagree on hosting A Day With Lady Mae at Calvary.
Uncle Clifford goes to war for the hearts and minds of Chucalissa; back at the club, the Pynk family comes together to prepare for its biggest night yet.
Folks from Biloxi to Atlanta pack out the Pynk to see two shining stars on an unforgettable night; Autumn's past finally catches up with her.
