Between the preacher dropping out, the bridal party falling apart, her ex trying to stop the wedding, a trip to the ER, and her own psychosis, the odds are stacked against Bridezilla Debra.
Nicole has a meltdown when she discovers a stain on her dress, and spends her whole wedding day screaming. Kirsten is an actress and doggie tutu designer who puts on quite the routine.
The one person who won't put up with spoiled Kirsten's manipulations is her wedding band leader...who Kirsten suddenly refuses to pay. LaJune thinks her fiance cheated...with her ex-best friend.

Renee is amped to finally get on the table for her full body makeover, but her 'easy-fix' suddenly turns into her plastic surgery nightmare. Meanwhile, Drita and Carla are ready to dive into summer fun as newly single ladies.

At Renee's party, Drita's make-up talk with Karen takes a vicious turn. Later, Junior finds out his sentencing from last year's mob bust and we learn of new mob wife's Ramona's infamous Mafia lineage.
In the aftermath of her party, Renee takes up her issues with the ladies' violent behavior and sets out to confront Carla. Drita takes some serious steps to deal with life after Lee.

programmes.st: You Don't Wanna Go to War with Me!
programmes.d: With Ramona in the mix, frenemy lines are fiercely drawn between the two camps of women. When Karen and Carla have a sit down, tempers flare as Karen declares war and Carla the 'Ice Princess' turns up the heat.

Renee's insecurities about Junior's past cheating ways start to resurface, and with Drita's help, Renee's curiosity leads to breaking into Junior's phone.
Malaysia doesn't believe Jennifer has turned over a new leaf, OG threatens Feby over an insulting rap, and Byron clarifies his role in the spreading of the Thomas rumor.
Jennifer calls out Cece over an incriminating text message, Tami pursues a new career path, and Shaunie's family celebrates Shareef's progress in his recovery.
Jen spreads gossip about Tami and Feby, causing tension between all the women involved, and when everyone gets together at a roller-skating party the wheels come off.
Malaysia, Feby and Jackie get into a near brawl, Evelyn tries to get Malaysia answers, Jackie and OG take the women to court, and Evelyn reconnects with her ex's daughter.
Jackie disrupts Jennifer's cancer benefit looking for a fight, OG sets up a meeting with Byron and Cece to help Kwame's career, and a negative story gets leaked to the press.

After an outlaw escapes from a stagecoach killing, Editor Claibourne spearheads a drive in Tombstone to raise a $5,000 reward for his capture, but this may cause problems for Sheriff Hollister who must also now deal with greedy bounty hunters.

Sheriff Clay Hollister rides the stage to Laramie with a court order concerning a murder indictment against a man named Rowan. Clay finds that his fellow passengers include Rowan himself (under an alias) and a hired gun paid to kill the Sheriff.

Reverend Tuttle is aboard the stagecoach when it is robbed by three masked gunmen. Sheriff Hollister suspects Big Jim Sten, boss of a nearby town, is behind the robbery. But when the reverend and Hollister visit Sten's town, a secret is revealed.

A cattle broker who deals with rustlers sets out to crush The Epitaph and Sheriff Clay Hollister, whose combined efforts are hurting his operations. He hires a has-been newspaperman to start a rival newspaper and the strategy seems to be succeeding!

Young and beautiful Liz Dolthan stands by as Hollister opens a safe to deposit personal valuables belonging to the stagecoach passengers. When the safe is robbed, Hollister devises a ruse to make Liz reveal the fact that she has an amazing memory.

Recently released from prison, Frank Leslie returns to Tombstone to marry the widow of the man he killed and pledges never to use guns again. But four brothers of Leslie's victim come to Tombstone intent on revenge, putting his oath to the test.

Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.
Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.

Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.
Tori agrees to help Jade find a theater to perform a play Jade wrote. But when the sponsor demands changes that will ruin Jade's play, Tori has to make things right before opening night.

A heat wave hits LA and the gang heads for the beach in Beck's RV. But once there, they find themselves trapped inside the RV as the temperature rises. Oblivious, Cat parties it up with some cute boys.
Tori's flight home is delayed, leaving her no time to finish a school project with her friends. She attempts to get the work done with them over video chat, but things keep getting in the way.

Tori's friends sing at a local karaoke club and end up competing with a pair of stuck-up girls who are regular performers there. Competing with those girls proves to be more difficult than they expect, since one of the girls' father owns the club.
Tori auditions for a role in a movie. But after exaggerating on her resume, she gets hired as a stunt double. When Tori finds out her stunt is falling off a building, she's not sure she can do it.
When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade.  Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.
The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

programmes.t: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?
programmes.d: Trina stars in Tori's directorial debut, and there is a big accident on opening night. Lane wants to find out what went wrong. Everyone thinks it was an equipment malfunction, maybe it's sabotage.

Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?
Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?
The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?
The kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other, because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz!
Tori and the gang are forced to spend a Saturday in detention after a lunch trip gone wrong. They have the whole day to learn about each other, find food, and try not to earn more detention.
iGo Nuclear: When Carly, Sam, and Freddie get an assignment at school to create an original project that benefits the environment, Carly ends up building an illegal nuclear-powered generator!

When Carly, Sam, and Freddie urge the iCarly fans to vote David Archuleta to victory on America Sings, they feel bad for the runner-up and help him make a music video.  Meanwhile, Sam teaches Spencer how to lie like a pro.

When Sam admits she has a crush on a boy at school, Carly teaches Sam how to entice him by acting more girly.  Meanwhile, Spencer is convinced that a girl likes him because of his tuxedo, so he starts wearing it all the time.
When Carly's old friend Missy moves back to Seattle, Sam believes Missy is trying to replace her as Carly's best friend.
When Carly, Sam, and Freddie lose the iCarly URL to Nevel, he demands Carly kiss him if she wants their URL back.  Meanwhile, Spencer has fun with the two hundred pillows he accidentally ordered.
When Sam and Freddie both win a contest for the best locker in school, they are forced to share the same locker.  Meanwhile, Carly asks Spencer to give her art lessons.

Carly, Sam, and Freddie present iCarly Awards for best user-generated content, giving the awards to the winners live on the web show.  Spencer enlists European swimsuit models to help him make the awards statuettes.
Freddie tries to prove that Melanie, Sam's twin sister, is just Sam in disguise.  Meanwhile, when Carly tutors Spencer's nemesis, Chuck, Spencer tries to convince her that Chuck is evil.
13-year-old Carly Shay and her friends, Sam and Freddie, create a homemade Web show called iCarly.  With Freddie behind the camera and Carly and Sam hosting the show, you never know what to expect!

When Sam accidentally reveals to Carly that she and Freddie shared a secret kiss, Carly confronts them both about why they never told her about it.  Meanwhile, Spencer goes to prison to teach an art class to convicts.

When Carly, Sam, and Freddie defeat a famous TV chef in a cooking challenge, the chef gives up cooking, quits his show, and refuses to come out of his bedroom.  Spencer tries to make his vision of the future a reality.

When Carly, Sam, and Freddie accidentally get Principal Franklin fired, Miss Briggs and Mr. Howard take control and enforce harsh rules.  Meanwhile, Spencer hires a grizzled old rodeo star to teach him to ride a mechanical bull.
When Sam announces a "take Carly to the dance contest" for an upcoming Girls' Choice dance, so many boys show up that Carly, Sam, and Freddie have to hold a speed-dating session to meet them all.

When Carly, Sam, and Freddie agree to make a music video for a pop star who's trying to make a comeback, they discover that she is out of shape and untalented. Spencer has trouble dating a woman when he discovers she's Gibby's mom.

The peaceful town of Mountain City, Tenn., is rocked when a beloved young couple are found brutally murdered in their home; as police search for their killer, they uncover a family enmeshed in sinister secrets and lies.

With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.
Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

After a short break, Monty's back at Longmeadow. With a change of seasons, he demonstrates how to prune summer fruiting raspberries, divides perennials and plants daffodils and hyacinths in containers.
Monty plants garlic, demonstrates how to divide crocosmia and sows ornamental grass seeds. Adam Frost visits Lowther Castle in the Lake District and finds out about its garden restoration project.

Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.
Monty plants mahonia for winter colour and scent, demonstrates how to take salvia cuttings and introduces a special addition to Longmeadow.

Monty starts work on revamping the writing garden, plants crocus bulbs and harvests pumpkins. Frances Tophill visits a unique plant conservation centre responsible for preserving key historical plants.

Monty plants a mix of white flowers in the writing garden, demonstrates how to prune a climbing rose and reviews what's been happening in the vegetable garden. Adam Frost celebrates seasonal colour on a visit to a garden in Essex, and Sue Kent pots up allium bulbs in readiness for spring and replants a tricky border with lavender she's grown from cuttings.
Monty harvests his loofahs, plants tulip bulbs in pots, gives a masterclass in making leafmould and reflects on the gardening year.

Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.
Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand foot vegetable garden.

Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

Monty and the team return with a celebration of spring. There's been plenty going on over the winter and lots of new projects in the garden to share. As well as getting on with some essential rose pruning, Monty plants clematis and rocket, cuts back grasses and makes a start on sowing annuals for colour this summer.

As plants begin to show their early growth, Monty gets plenty of plants for free when he demonstrates how to make the most of herbaceous perennials. He also cuts back pelargoniums that have overwintered in the greenhouse and makes a start on sowing vegetables. Nick Bailey shares plans for his new garden in Northamptonshire and shows how to create a container garden ideal for those on the move. Frances Tophill discovers more ways to use cut flowers as she visits a florist in Devon.

Frank & Raimy plan to kill the Nightingale, but Frank finds himself agonizing over whether it's the right thing to do. And Raimy is confronted with an unexpected moral decision.
Raimy and Frank find themselves in the thick of things. Meanwhile, Frank learns the meaning behind a betrayal.
Raimy and Frank make a huge discovery while continuing their search for the Nightingale killer. Meanwhile, Stan is willing to do anything to bring Frank down.
In the season finale, the truth is revealed and Raimy makes a discovery that stops her cold. She quickly reaches out to Frank on the ham radio to voice her concerns.

In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.  The robber's planning is meticulous.  He executes his crimes with military precision.  It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents  to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship.  They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI.  These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death.  The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

In the 1980s, the drug trade ravages Chicago's inner city neighborhoods and violent crime threatens to destroy entire communities. As drug profits grow, gangs rule the streets.  One of the most dangerous is the El Rukns. FBI Agents team up with state and local police to bring them down, but in the process, uncover a bizarre and frightening terrorist plot.

In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary.  The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy.  The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack.   Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports.  One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.  The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted,  hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link.  Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero.  He had a gun and was willing to shoot.  The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way.  The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

In 1987, Seven inmates break out of a high security prison in New Mexico. The escapees, all violent criminals, are a threat to anyone who crosses their path. State and local police and the FBI know they must capture these men before they rob, rape and kill…again.

In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns.  Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.  As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

In the winter of 2001, two well-loved and respected college professors are found murdered in their home.  Nothing about the case makes sense.  No items are missing from the home and the couple had no known enemies.  Local police and FBI agents form a task force to find a pair of homegrown killers and a motive for the brutal crime they committed.

In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorizes the town of East Point.  Two people are killed, and two are critically wounded.  At first the shootings seem targeted, then they seem random.  As the body count climbs, the killer taunts law enforcement with mysterious notes.  Agents believe the shooter will continue until he is deador behind bars.

In the early 90s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands began smuggling thousands of kilos of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America,  local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI  work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.  Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home.  Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba. Una investigación del FBI a gran escala llevó a la recuperación de los cuerpos de los hombres asesinados y la evidencia física fue recuperada y analizada. Los laboratorios del FBI confirmaron que todas excepto una de las balas usadas para asesinar a los hombres provenían de la misma arma.  El FBI se ganó la confianza de un informante, cuy

In Anchorage, Alaska, a young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered.  There was only one piece of forensic evidence: a washrag carrying pubic lice that the killer used to clean himself after the crime.  Employing an unusual and original method, an FBI expert combed through all the hairs and fibers in the apartment.  He was not only able to determine how long each hair had been there, but which hairs came from the killer and how the crime proceeded.

Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise.  But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham.  Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft.  But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun.   The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy.  The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared.   Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers.  But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived.  Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy.  A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides.  But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed.  After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later.  Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes.  Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl.  Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage.  Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building.  During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble.  The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom.  Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano.  The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law.  But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family.  With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer.  Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune.  Most ended up dead.  As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage.  The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program.  The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime:  a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed.  Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin.  In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight.  He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes.  Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer.  Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved.  Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed.  FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town.  They turned to the FBI labs.  The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim.  Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move.  Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down.  He was at home in the rugged terrain.  But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home.  The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere.  But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings.  Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's.  Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed.  When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged.  The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear.  Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president.  With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics.  Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children.  The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple.  Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off.  The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home.  The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed.  Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child.  Both had been murdered.  Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car.  The hair was too small for analysis.

La vida de Víctor es bastante tranquila. Pasa las noches con su madre escuchando boleros o viendo películas de la epoca de Oro del cine mexicano en la television.

La economia ha colapsado. En un universo de pobreza moral y economica, Flavia, una adolescente mimada con aspiraciones artisticas, no es aceptada en la universidad. Su vecino Martin, un hombre maduro con rutinas rigidas, es su opuesto. Entre ellos hay friccion constante.

En una casa casi en ruinas, conviven cinco jovenes y un gato, el unico habitante permanente. Vienen de lugares y culturas opuestas. La llegada de un inquilino extravagante los convierte en una familia disfuncional y efimera.

Esteban pone fin a su vida al lanzarse desde un puente hacia una presa, lo que lo transporta a un universo onírico. Allí emprende un viaje de purgatorio en el que debe enfrentarse a sus inseguridades y a la condena de vivir bajo el mando de su padre, un jerarca despótico que gobierna a la familia.
Neimar quiere sentir la presencia de Dios, si tan solo pudiera descubrir como. Mientras tanto, busca una felicidad que entra en conflicto con las complejidades de la vida real.
Cristina, de 43 años, atraviesa un embarazo de alto riesgo y vive una noche trágica al enterarse de que una explosión ha afectado el lugar donde se cree que se encuentra su hija adolescente, Amalia.
Emprendimos un recorrido en barco de 32 km que, en cada parada, nos permitió conectar con experiencias vitales en torno a diversas realidades socioambientales vinculadas al río Suquía.
Emilia, contemplando la maternidad en un mundo pospandemico, forma una conexion inesperada con su deprimido vecino anciano, Felipe.

Tras salir de prisión, donde aprendió a cuidar a los enfermos, Alma una mujer albina está decidida a recuperar algo mucho más importante que su propia libertad. Para lograrlo, se ve obligada a cuidar por las noches a Clemente, un hipocondríaco obsesionado compulsivamente con evitar una muerte súbita. Su relación evolucionará de la desconfianza y el miedo hacia la compasión, la ternura y el amor.

Santa y Toya son dos amigos que comparten la pasión por el ciclismo y deciden emprender una aventura juntos. Lucharán contra viento y marea para ayudar a Santa a convertirse en ciclista profesional. A lo largo de su viaje, descubren que el verdadero valor del ciclismo no reside en ganar carreras, sino en la amistad y la camaradería que surgen entre ellos mientras persiguen un sueño.

When Chelsea Simms, the good-hearted brand strategist for the popular dating app The Nice List, discovers the app has granted her magical powers, she uses her newfound ability to make all of the �naughty� people in her life learn how to be good again. But when her plans go awry and Fisher, the kindly neighbor who has always carried a torch for Chelsea, is magically added to the naughty list by mistake, Chelsea must race against time to set things right before Christmas Eve.

programmes.t: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
programmes.d: When New York City lawyer Julia Crawley returns to her Rocky Mountain hometown and her family’s lovely inn for the holidays, she finds herself at the center of a generations-old feud with the family that runs the town’s other inn. As the ongoing competition between the two inns escalates, “forbidden” romance blossoms between Julia and Roger Mason, whose family runs the inn that is her family’s big competitor.

Cub reporter Sophia thinks she's found a Christmas story that will save her career when she discovers a long-lost, undelivered Secret Santa gift. Trying to uncover and bring closure to the overdue present before Christmas, Sophia discovers much more than she could have hoped for when she discovers that the gift is not only priceless but stolen.

When egotistical social media influencer DD Ward's dog is shockingly kidnapped, her long-suffering and under-appreciated assistant Emily forms an alliance with a down to earth local veterinarian to find the puppy before Christmas. As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

Sydney, a go-getting federal agent, finds out that her down-on-his luck confidential informant in a criminal investigation suddenly goes missing, she begins a desperate scramble to continue her investigation. However, her luck hasn’t run out yet when she finds a man who is her informant's mirror image. She recruits this doppelgänger to play his role.

Brooke and Roger, two graphic designers in a soon-to-be-merged company, help one another by agreeing to a loveless marriage of convenience, suggested by their new boss. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage the sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend during the holidays. But, with their “marriage” in question, will Brooke and Roger find a spark they didn’t know existed?

With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

programmes.t: A Christmas Castle Proposal: A Royal In Paradise 2
programmes.d: Olivia meets charming Alexander on the tropical Haven Isles, unaware he’s a prince. As they explore the island, friendship turns to romance—until a royal spy reveals his identity. Invited to spend Christmas at his majestic palace, Olivia faces royal traditions, strict protocol, and comedic culture clashes. Amid the chaos, love is tested, but a magical Christmas might bring the proposal of a lifetime.

After a bad review Isabel is fired from her job as a successful pastry chef. Ready to start over she decides to open her own bakery in the small town of Shady Oaks. Struggling to adapt to the new area Isabel finds an old recipe book that brings inspiration back to her baking. When she discovers a secret code in the recipes Isabel sets out to solve a Christmas mystery.

Every Christmas, the wealthy Sterlings gather at their remote estate to keep tradition alive. But when patriarch Harold Sterling is found poisoned after hinting at a shocking change to his will, buried secrets erupt. With the sheriff away, puzzle editor Vera Vexley and Deputy Neal race against time to unmask the killer among ambitious heirs, a loyal lawyer, and mysterious guests—before greed, lies, and betrayal claim another life.

Colbie, an ambitious designer at Klein and Smith, is hired to decorate the historic Chapman House for its Christmas Ball. Working with Ben, the charming estate manager, sparks fly despite a rocky start. As chemistry builds, new jobs and past loves stir doubt. But through the magic of the season, they discover that love is the greatest gift of all.

Journalist Mary is assigned a Christmas story on the beloved holiday toy, Mistle Toad, celebrating its big anniversary. Though wary of the assignment—since the manufacturer is a major advertiser—she's promised full editorial freedom. In the toy’s hometown, she meets Blake, the founder’s son, who’s hesitant to speak out against his father’s overly commercial vision. As Mary digs for the real story, unexpected sparks begin to fly.

An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

Katrina Marks, author of �Just Say No to Ho, Ho, Ho,� plans to celebrate Christmas secretly after a tough year. She must evade Hunter Williams, a persistent TV reporter aiming to expose her, though she feels undeniable chemistry with him. Katrina joins �Christmas Lovers Anonymous� to indulge her Christmas spirit and meets a special guy. To her surprise, her online friend and Hunter share more in common than she realizes.

Daisy, a determined real estate broker, inherits her grandfather’s ranch just before Christmas. Focused on selling, she returns home only to reconnect with Ben, her childhood crush who now works as a ranch hand. As holiday traditions stir memories and rekindle old feelings, Daisy begins to question the fast-paced career she’s built. With the season drawing to a close, she must decide between ambition and love.

After failing in business and in love, a downtrodden Felicity Olson moves back home with one goal: make enough money to reclaim her life in Chicago. But when a handsome, Christmas-loving dairy farmer inspires her to start a new baking business, their connection challenges Felicity to find the positive in life and rekindle her holiday spirit once again.

Katie is excited to ﬁnally have a boyfriend to bring home for the holidays. But when she gets dumped by her boyfriend Dean, she hires Josh to be him for Christmas with her family. As Katie spends more time with Josh she realizes that their relationship might have something real but when Dean shows up to beg her back, Katie must make a choice, between the life she thought she wanted, and the love that’s right in front of her.

Jessica has a big presentation in Palm Springs. There are a couple of problems though: her two kids who will do anything to get mom and dad back together again - even if they have to hack mom's phone or pose as a secretary to make sure dad's in Palm Springs too. And father Joe who'll do anything to charm his way back into Jessica's life.

The holiday season is alive in New York, where a ballet rehearsal for The Nutcracker is underway. Carrie, the prima ballerina, focuses on guiding the young dancers around her. Meanwhile, Prince William is tasked with escorting Medea, a rising star ballerina, to New York. Medea's arrival disrupts the growing bond between Carrie and the Prince. When Medea is injured, the question arises: will Carrie step in to save the performance? Christmas magic may lead to more than just a show.

To save their struggling radio show, a young producer launches a live holiday segment setting up her recently separated boss on a series of blind dates. The ratings soar, and the buzz grows—but things get complicated when she unexpectedly falls for one of the charming contenders. As Christmas approaches, she must choose between her career ambitions and a shot at real love before the final date airs.

Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

When Veronika Daniels's co-host leaves "Rise and Shine," she opens auditions for replacements, including Charlie Fisher, a seasoned NY newscaster, and Emily Morgan, a spirited human interest reporter. Emily's unexpected viral plea for the job intensifies the competition. As they vie for the role leading up to the Christmas Day Telethon, old romantic feelings between Charlie and Emily resurface, adding a new layer of complexity to their professional rivalry.

Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.
After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

A former serial killer Byung-su gets diagnosed with Alzheimer’s. When a series of murders occur near his town, Byung-su gets worried whether the killings are his doings during his memory lapses. But then, he comes across Tae-ju and instinctively realizes that he's the serial killer. He reports this to the police, only to learn that Tae-ju is one. With his memory slipping, Byung-su must find a way to protect his daughter from Tae-ju.

Four years after the sweeping operation of Garibong-dong, Detective Ma Seok-do and his unit have an extradition mission - to transfer a surrendered suspect from Vietnam. When Ma and Team Leader Jeon meet him, he seems fearful of something. Ma and Jeon find out that he gets involved in a kidnap/murder case: the victim is a young businessman whose father is the giant loan shark in Seoul. The leader of the crime, Kang Hae-sang, is responsible for several other kidnap/murder cases targeting Koreans
In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues
A man looking for the release of a long-time prisoner takes a police officer, his daughter, and a group of strangers hostage.
An illegal immigrant from Mainland China sneaks into the corrupt British-colonized Hong Kong in 1963, transforming himself into a ruthless drug lord.
A coming-of-age story and a feel-great, rip-roaring romp about a group of high school girls who shake a sleepy town alive with pom-poms and perfectly synchronized cheerleading routines.
An expelled boxing champion, who now is a high-school teacher, witnesses intolerable violence and throws her first punch to build justice against it, while putting on a mask.

programmes.t: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programmes.d: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human sp
Two professors team up to locate a lost treasure and embark on an adventure that takes them from a Tibetan ice cave to Dubai, and to a mountain temple in India.
A young housewife in a seemingly perfect marriage develops pica, the irresistible urge to ingest inedible objects and material.

Living a life of isolation and frustration, a young man develops an unexpected friendship with a reclusive heiress. When that relationship meets its tragic end, his loneliness and anger culminates into the most nihilistic and heinous of acts.

Murderous consequences unravel in the dead of night as the lives of two assassins, a teacher, a janitor and a waitress intertwine at the hands of a mysterious criminal mastermind who's out for revenge.

programmes.t: True History of the Kelly Gang
programmes.d: An exploration of Australian bushranger Ned Kelly and his gang as they attempt to evade authorities during the 1870s.

In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.
A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.

Clare, a young Irish convict, chases a British officer through the Tasmanian wilderness and is bent on revenge for a terrible act of violence the man committed against her family. On the way, she enlists the services of Aboriginal tracker Billy.
A seemingly normal security guard (Armand Assante) reveals a sinister side.
Eight candidates cooperate in order to secure a job with a prestigious company.
Before he is executed, Arthur Blake relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls to a priest.
A married Hollywood agent receives a mysterious letter for an anonymous sexual encounter and becomes ensnared in a sinister world of lying, murder and infidelity.
Three ex-cons (Nicolas Cage, Willem Dafoe, Christopher Matthew Cook) find themselves on the run from the mob and the police after botching a plan to kidnap a baby for a large ransom.
A British intelligence officer turns into a whistleblower after learning about NSA espionage plans designed to ensure passage of a resolution of war against Iraq by the U.N. Security Council in 2003.

After his wife Lisa disappears on a business trip, Peter finds evidence that she has been having an affair with Ralph. He flies to Milan and enters into a complicated charade by befriending Ralph and slowly teasing information about Lisa out of him.
A young woman born into an all-female cult begins to question the teachings of her leader.

Syd sells illegal samples of live viruses from sick celebrities to piracy groups, smuggling them in his own body. He becomes infected with the disease that kills Hannah Geist. He must unravel the mystery of her death before he suffers the same fate.
A wrong turn leaves a college student stranded in the wintry woods, where she aligns with an enigmatic loner to survive the elements -- and the outlaws pursuing her.
Armed with a few clues and an in-depth knowledge of Sherlock Holmes lore, an ice-factory worker (Cris Lankenau) leads his sister and a co-worker on a search for his missing former lover.

programmes.t: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programmes.d: To get his dog back, private eye Steve Ford forges an unlikely alliance with Spyder, the leader of a local gang. With help from his best friend, Steve pulls out the big guns to retrieve Spyder's missing cash and cocaine and save his beloved pooch.
Diagnosed with a fatal condition, a mob enforcer leaves prison after 19 years and plots a bloody course of revenge against his old gang.

It's finally the day of the Saint Ishiyama School Festival and the big volleyball match! But the match doesn't happen until the afternoon, so Furuichi decides to enjoy the school festival atmosphere, specifically the Maid Cafe that Azusa and her class are running. Unfortunately things get a bit out of hand...

Don Kecchi, the wealthiest man in America, is terminally ill and has announced that he's donating his entire fortune to charity. However, Lupin steals Kecchi's money and shoots Fujiko right in front of Inspector Zenigata!

Marguerite Tiffany, the owner of Tiffany's and a TV anchor, hires Lupin and his gang to rob her jewelry store on live TV. Initially, Lupin refuses, but ends up having to go through with it thanks to Fujiko's wild spending habits.
The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.
Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

programmes.d: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

Chris' mother Lindsey is shooting a movie in an old castle and Sonic and his friends are there to visit as well. However, they begin to notice that something is amiss as ghostly figures begin to appear.
Sonic and his friends are on a cruise when the Egg Fort appears inside a glacier. As Sonic faces his foes, he receives some help from Knuckles.
Sam Speed challenges Sonic to a race on his new racing car. After much plodding, Sonic accepts the challenge but Eggman decides to interrupt the whole ordeal with his newly invented robot "Sumo-Man".

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.
A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.

The Clampetts load their shootin' irons for a match with the Drysdales when Sonny jilts Elly May
A rancher, Andy, is good friends with Ben, but his son (Todd) wants to sell their land for mining operations which will spoil the water rights agreement that Andy and Ben made.
First plane ride for the Clampetts to visit cousin Pearl.
The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.
A woman dies. Her husband is in prison, and the sheriff needs someone to look after the boy. The Cartwrights begin to take care of the boy at the Ponderosa.
Pearl's efforts to snag Mr. Brewster seem doomed until he makes a ridiculous public proposal.
Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.
An outlaw gang robs Virginia City's bank and makes off with almost all of its money. The youngest member of the gang manages to get a job on the Ponderosa as a bronc-buster.
Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.
Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.
Charlie Trent used to be an Army scout. Now he's the town drunk. Hoss helps him regain his self-esteem when he has him volunteer to lead a gold-bearing troop through the desert.
Hoss and Little Joe are mistaken for bloodthirsty hired killers in a small Texas town dominated by two feuding families.
Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.
Two of Cousin Pearl's most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills.
The Cartwrights come to the aid of a Chinese-American stable hand accused of murder. Opposing them is a manipulative candidate who wants all "foreigners" to leave Virginia City.
Police find Granny's still.
Duke, Jed's bloodhound, becomes matchmaker.
While hunting a predator wolf, Little Joe finds a gypsy woman who has been rejected from her people because she is believed to be a witch.
A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.
Jed is made a bank vice president so he can compete in an interbank skeet shoot.
When a powerful gang plagues Virginia City with a murderous protection racket, the Cartwrights are determined to stop it even as it threatens them.

Mrs. Drysdale wants to get rid of the Clampett's before the arrival of Mrs. Smith-Standish, the head of a 'first family' historical society. Mrs. Smith-Standish goes to the Clampetts first and becomes enchanted with their antiques and way of life. She ropes Mrs. Drysdale into helping with chores done the old way, to her horror.
Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.
After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life by gunning down two men, he eventually reveals that he's in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwrights to Sacramento to testify.
Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.
Granny chases off IRS man with a gun.
The Cartwrights' neighbor Tom Edwards has lived as a paraplegic, ever since an accident involving Ben Cartwright and a gun. His ranch is going to waste.
Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.
Jed falls for beautiful Beverly Hills matron.
Jacob Darien is leading his family of Quakers through Virginia City. When he is accosted by town roughnecks, Adam Cartwright steps in with the help of his new traveling companion.
Drysdale will get a raise when he signs the Clampett account.
Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious accident.
Ranchers are being killed, cattle stolen, and even after former U.S. Deputy Marshal Denver McKee sends posses after the suspects, they are never found.
Prejudice erupts on both sides when Ben gives an Indian named Matsou and his wife some of his land, after saving Ben's life from a renegade Indian who almost killed him.
The Clampetts have a series of unusual encounters with a Beverly Hills psychiatrist.
A Beverly Hills psychiatrist pursues Granny instead of Pearl when Granny's love potion misfires.
Jennifer Beale is abducted in the hopes her rich father, Joshua, the richest silver baron on the Comstock, will pay a $1M ransom.
Clampetts offer to help at Drysdale's bank.
Clampetts show Jethros's friend how to have fun.
Dolly Kincaid is so fed up with her extremely dominant, controlling, sheriff father, that she runs away with her boyfriend.
Jed fakes an illness to please Granny.
Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.
Gunnar is a long-lost relative of the Cartwright family. When Gunnar arrives at the Ponderosa, the family takes him in for the evening.
Her neighbors are aghast when Granny decides to start a vegetable garden on the mansion grounds.
A new fashion patterned after the Clampetts comes to Beverly Hills.
After Joe kills a man in self-defense who tried to set fire to the Ponderosa, he has to take his feisty daughter home, and she and her relatives are now determined to kill Joe.
Jethro, after a man-to-man talk with Jed, wastes no time in finding a girlfriend.
Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to "marry up" with Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brought home.
The Cartwrights try to disprove the validity of a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from seizing part of the Ponderosa and the Carson Valley settlers' lands.
Jed receives news that his multimillion-dollar account is overdrawn by $34.70.
The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.
About to set out on a cattle drive, Ben hires a young drifter named Sam Jackson as one of his drovers, but Jackson is really outlaw determined to kill his father, Waycross sheriff.
Mrs. Drysdale's turkey escapes to the Clampett household.
Clampetts attend Drysdale garden party when told not to.
Adam rides up on some Indians wanting to harm a white woman they believed was a mountain spirit. He kills them but the rest of the tribe is still out there looking for her.
Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.
Clampetts have trouble getting acquainted with neighbors.
A wrench is thrown in the works, and at the car, when Froy and Matt try to repo from a plumber.
Matt and Froy get some help from a friendly gardener that lead them to discover a car hidden in the backyard.
Lou, Sonia, and Froy have to push away a debtor while trying to push a classic car up a hill.

Matt and Froy have to choose between the job and their lives.
Lou, Matt, & Froy face owner with blade. Matt & Froy reclaim Prius from role-players.

Matt & Froy call cops for old-timer. Lou & Froy clash with bowler. Froy & Lyndah deal with Altima owner.
Lou & Sonia pursue Porsche & Audi. Matt & Froy recover truck. Matt & Lou seize BMW from rich couple.
Lou devises a plan to have Froy and Sonia pose as house buyers.
Froy, Lou & Matt face bodybuilders for Jeep. Lou & Lyndah startle broker. Froy learns text lesson from Sonia.
Matt & Lou handle accountant & son. Sonia & Froy manage pool party. They chase a hearse.
Sonia & Lou encounter economy impact. Matt & Sonia deal with spoiled princess and unpaid bill on Jetta.

Matt and Froy repossess a car from a cheating husband who's shacked up at a nearby motel.
Froy and Sonia trace an out-of-state skip account to a seedy motel.
Sonia and Froy storm a studio to repossess a Corvette from a surly European photographer.
Sonia and Froy respond to a tip from an informant and wind up in the middle of an epic story of intrigue.
Matt and Froy interrupt a comedian's preparations for a show to repossess his Dodge.
Matt and Froy interrupt a debtor's tattooing session to reclaim his vehicle.

Lou and Froy repo a vehicle in a bad part of town and somebody gets punched in the face.

Matt and Froy walk into a moral gray area when they repossess a vehicle by stealing it.
Lou and Matt confront a big-time player and his bodyguards at a Brazilian restaurant.

Lou, Matt & Froy retry a bus repo & take a crane, while Sonia & Froy are chased by bikers to the office.
Sonia & Matt face skaters, Froy & Sonia repo from a volatile couple, & Lou & Froy take on backyard wrestlers.
First, Matt and Froy get the worst service ever from a street-side coffee vendor who won't give up his truck.

First, Lou and Sonia make their way to a home in the hills to clean a germaphobe of his car.
First, Lou and Sonia have an order for a Jaguar behind a retail outlet center.

Lou and his cousin Rob face trouble on the job when a debtor makes shocking claims to police.
After Froy bails him out from a Tijuana prison, Matt is on the warpath, and somebody needs to pay.
Lou, Matt, Sonia, Froy, and Lyndah are back together and better than ever.

With their truck gone, the team fights on - repossessing a van, facing a wild baker.
With Matt onboard, the team repos a rich kid's ride, an "Uncle Sam" vehicle, and battles rowdy rugby players.
Take a look inside the fast-paced, high pressure world of car repossession with highly trained professionals.
The confusion over Lou's new business relationship with Matt continues to mount.
The new truck arrives, fueling the growing feud between Team Lou and Team Matt.
After Froy's injury on a repo, tensions between Lou and Matt reach new heights.

After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.
A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?
A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.
A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.
A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.
April 1862, in the Arizona territory. During the opening months of the Civil War, two enemy soldiers must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Sonoran Desert.
A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.
A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.
Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.
Recently released from prison, Harvey Miller reunites with his three best friends to rob and enact revenge on a local drug kingpin.

Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

Ten people arrive at a secluded mountain resort to find it completely deserted. With no gas for the return trip, the visitors are forced to stay and investigate the mystery surrounding the abandoned lodge.
A young girl taught to be unfazed by death grows up to be a dangerous woman with very peculiar desires.
A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.
The terrifying journey of Charley who, after a near-death experience, is haunted by her relationship with her deceased mother.

After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?
As a murder victim's sisters dedicate themselves to finding the killer, an unexpected source turns the case upside down.

When Leslie Neulander dies after what appears to be an accidental fall in the shower in her New York home, two friends join forces to seek justice on her behalf; insiders speak out on the latest twists and the final chapter in the case.
A teenager's life is turned upside down by a shocking discovery as what seems like a fatal accident reveals itself to be something much more disturbing.
A young woman is found dead in an empty warehouse parking lot in Miami -- just four days after her wedding.
When 16-year-old Britney Ujlaky disappears, a small town in Nevada bands together to track down a potential suspect - an unknown cowboy; soon, their focus turns to someone much closer to Britney.

While responding to a house fire in New Jersey, firefighters discover the burned remains of the homeowner in the basement; new interviews and legal developments about the latest twists and turns in the case.
A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.
A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother, who was killed when Sarah was seven.
A Connecticut bank executive is targeted by criminals who force him to rob his own bank.

A beloved Staten Island teacher is found dead in the home she shared with her husband; an unknown number in her cell phone leads investigators to reveal troubles in her seemingly idyllic life -- and to ultimately unearth her killer.
When a luxury car dealer is found dead, detectives suspect one of his lovers, but lack of evidence stalls the case for a year until one clue breaks it wide open.
Detectives suspect an inside job when a coin collector and his wife are found dead in their home with no sign of forced entry or evidence of theft.
A successful businesswoman falls for a banker who may not be who he seems.
An arrest is finally made five years after a mother of four disappeared while she was close to her apartment in Montana.
A man who was arrested and tried three times for the death of his wife of four months talks about the case.
The remains of 11 female bodies are found in the desert outside of Albuquerque, N.M.
When police find a prominent lawyer dead and his girlfriend bound in duct tape, their investigation leads to a surprising suspect.
When a woman kills the man she suspects of being involved in an attack that left her husband dead and her young son wounded, she claims self-defense.

Detectives look into a couple's complicated past when a man finds his wife stabbed to death in their home.
A man and his son are shot to death, tearing their family apart.
A Jacksonville, Fla., firefighter discovers a disturbingly violent scene in his darkened bedroom on a Halloween weekend.
A son uncovers a dark family conspiracy when he questions his mother following a man's apparent suicide.

An investigation into the murder of a beloved couple in South Carolina reveals a feud and divides a family.
