Your day 5 practice introduces principles of stability or Sthira. Though this practice we learn to to steady the mind as we strengthen the body. Build on yesterday’s practice to marry effort with ease. Invite your breath to be smooth and even as we continue to build on your foundation.

Your day 6 practice invites you to use core work to get clear. In this session we use controlled movement to activate the muscles of the abdominal for a strong and healthy back and strengthen your whole self.

Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Day 1 welcomes you to Desire Mapping—an approach to living guided by how you want to feel, not just what you want to do. By shifting from goal lists to heart-centered intention, this introduction invites you to honor presence, intuition, and the feelings that shape a fulfilling life.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Desire Mapping guides you to live from the heart, focusing on how you want to feel rather than just what you want to do. Through practices like Soul Limber, appreciation, attention management, Core Desired Feelings, and exploring your inner selves, you gain clarity, agency, joy, and purpose in creating a fulfilling life.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Set down your Core Desired Feelings and explore the words that shape your inner world. This practice reveals patterns, clarifies your choices, and turns intention into living energy. Your feelings and words become a beacon, guiding you to live from the heart with focus and purpose.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Step into Intentional Creation using your Core Desired Feelings as your guide. Align actions with heart-centered intentions, release what no longer serves you, and transform your goals into sacred desires. Cultivate agency, joy, and flow as your inner world shapes your outer reality.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Integrate your Core Desired Feelings through daily practice, reflection, and heart-centered rituals. Using mindfulness, breath, and prayer, cultivate sacred connection, peace, and purpose. Return to your heart each day, and let your love and clarity ripple into the world.
Admissions tells a transformational tale about what it takes to find lasting peace.
How fascia, light, water, and emotion form the body's true intelligence and why nature disconnection drives disease.
How one woman defied a terminal diagnosis through radical inner work, proving consciousness directs biology and healing begins when we remember our power.
Why your wellness routines might be avoidance and how seeing the invisible lens shaping your reality is the only true path to freedom.

programmes.t: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programmes.d: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programmes.t: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programmes.d: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programmes.t: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programmes.d: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Terri Cole, licensed psychotherapist, who talks about how to have healthy boundaries and thereby much more balance in your life. She shares ways to set healthy boundaries in order to have your real voice and feelings be heard. She is a global relationship and empowerment expert, and the author of Boundary Boss-The Essential Guide to Talk True, Be Seen and (Finally) Live Free.

Host Lisa Garr interviews William Peters, who is recognized as a global leader in the field of near death and shared death studies and has spent decades studying end-of-life experiences. He is the founder of the Shared Crossing Project and director of its Research Initiative. His latest book is At Heaven's Door: What Shared Journeys to the Afterlife Teach About Dying Well and Living Better.
Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

Bring a clear intention to your practice today, looking inward to ask: How would I like to take a stand in the world? Qigong offers a safe, supportive way to place your attention on the intention of being lit by the light of the sun. That is, moving in the world with clear direction, lightness, and heart-led purpose.

This practice is a culmination and celebration of all you’ve learned in this class, allowing you the opportunity to practice all eight Silk Brocades and experience the emotional, mental, physical, and spiritual benefits of qigong.
In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Darin Olien who explains the importance of nature and mindfulness practices for revolutionizing our health and happiness.

Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

Leidy Johana García tuvo una hija con José Luis Mota, su primer novio, pero la relación terminó por problemas económicos. José Luis, incapaz de aceptar la separación de su hija, asesinó a golpes a Leidy en un ataque de ira. Fue capturado por la comunidad al intentar huir. Tras dos años y medio de juicio, fue condenado por homicidio simple a una pena mínima excarcelable y quedó en libertad.
Danna Cervantes desapareció en diciembre de 2017 tras salir de clases en Sincelejo. Su cuñado, Crusto Díaz, la engañó para abusarla y asesinarla en venganza contra su hermana.

La familia Peña, famosa por su negocio de papas y altruismo, enfrentó extorsión y amenazas. Milciades intentó proteger a Rubiela y su hija, pero la situación trágicamente terminó en un triple asesinato.

Luz Stella García fue asesinada por su esposo Luis Antonio Quilcue tras años de celos y violencia. Él alegó defensa propia y recibió una condena reducida de 5 años y 4 meses, pese a evidencia de premeditación.

La muerte de Diana Marcela es el resultado de una historia de celos, pasion, traicion que destruyen a toda una familia. Tras las investigaciones de la fiscalía a causa del homicidio, se destapan secretos que sorprenden a la familia, vecinos y pareja de la víctima.

En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

Una familia campesina se muda a Cali buscando un mejor futuro para su hija Jaqueline, de 10 años. En 2012, la niña desaparece misteriosamente. Meses después, su cuerpo es hallado en un cañaduzal. Las investigaciones señalan a Óscar Eduardo Cadavid, esposo de su tía, como principal sospechoso. Capturado en 2013, fue condenado a 43 años de prisión por desaparición forzada.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.
Daniella Álvarez, ex señorita Colombia, perdió su pierna izquierda tras complicadas cirugías. Con valor, enfrenta terapias diarias y sueña con una fundación para ayudar a otros.

El periodista Herbin Hoyos murió por COVID-19 a los 53 años. Secuestrado por las FARC durante 17 días, creó "Las Voces del Secuestro", programa radial que durante 24 años envió mensajes de esperanza a secuestrados, jugando un papel clave en rescates como la Operación Jaque. Ganó 84 premios de periodismo y dio 11.567 "abrazos de la libertad" a quienes ayudó a sobrevivir.

¡Shatoria le sigue diciendo a D'Eric que él no es el padre del hijo de su hermana Latasha! ¡Luego, el exnovio de CiCi, Angel, le niega el bebé porque su mejor amigo Ralphie lo dice! ¡Los resultados te dejarán sin palabras!
Michelle sospecha que Dwayne usa un alias y engaña con su hermana Tiffany. Colleen, cansada de mentiras, quiere saber si él oculta una vida sexual secreta como “¡Gran Papá Russ!”.

Sheroya tiene 17 años y se esfuerza por criar a 2 niños mientras sale de fiesta sin parar. Su novio Malcolm suele ser infiel y la maltrata verbalmente. Steve tiene mucho trabajo por delante con esta pareja, pero ¿alguno de ellos despertará?

Jatavious ha vuelto para averiguar si fue el padre de los dos hijos de su novia. Freddie sospechó que su novia Amanda faltó al trabajo para engañarlo y no cree que sus nuevos gemelos sean suyos. ¡No te pierdas estos increíbles resultados de ADN!

Cuando la gente normal necesita ayuda, Steve Wilkos está listo para responder a la llamada. Mira cómo Steve ayuda a la gente normal a defenderse y a luchar por sus creencias para promover la justicia para todos.

Josh dice que su mundo se arruinó cuando su novia dio a luz a su hijo, por lo que se acostó con su hermana; Derrick quiere dejar a su novio para poder ser soltero, libre y capaz de hacer sus propias cosas.

La stripper Brittany se enfrenta a un compañero de trabajo que se acostó con uno de los clientes de Brittany; la mamá del bebé de Bebo confiesa haberse acostado con su mejor amigo; tres invitados le dan una sorpresa.

Carl ha venido a decirle a su novia que se ha estado acostando con su peor enemiga, Keisha. A continuación, Donte le dirá a su mejor amigo, Quincy, que está acostándose con su prometida. Después, Janel y Nikkie están peleando por el mismo hombre.
Johnny quiere que su novia Aimee lo acepte como es. Después, Maya viene al programa para confrontar a su novio Eric sobre sus costumbres.
Destiny confiesa una aventura; Kashe admite acostarse con la novia de su primo y estalla pelea; dos hombres compiten en un concurso de comida para conquistar a Amber.

Colombia es el tercer destino preferido para cirugías plásticas, pero muchos extranjeros han fallecido durante estos procedimientos. Casos como el de María Isabel Rosado y Maira Sánchez revelan riesgos y negligencias médicas. Se buscan regulaciones más estrictas para proteger a los pacientes.

Marco Lino Niño, Ana Julia Sánchez y Rosa Helena Restrepo sufrieron maltratos en hogares geriátricos, resultando en sus muertes. Sus familias buscan justicia y denuncian negligencia y maltrato. Las investigaciones están en curso, mientras los hogares siguen operando.

El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco se ha convertido en un caso de gran controversia. La Fiscalía acusa a su esposo, de montar una escena para ocultar su culpabilidad. La investigación revela posibles motivos económicos.

Juan José, de 7 años, falleció ahogado en una piscina sin salvavidas en Melgar. Deisy Riaño murió y su pareja quedó en estado vegetativo por inhalar monóxido de carbono en un glamping sin licencia en Manta. César Bolaños se ahogó en el Parque Tayrona, donde no había salvavidas. Las familias buscan justicia.
Los adolescentes luchan contra trastornos de salud mental que les hacen terminar prematuramente con sus vidas.

En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.
Dos hombres usan alias en Tinder para estafar a varias mujeres por miles de dólares.

En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. La investigación reveló que Jenny mantenía una relación con su ex esposo, Fabián Rendón, quien motivado por celos y venganza planeó el doble feminicidio junto a su cómplice Sebastián Muriel, administrador de un hotel local. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.
El veintiuno (21) de abril de dos mil once (2011) en Caicedonia (Valle) ocurre el atroz asesinato de Jenifer Hoyos una niña de nueve (9) años a manos de Yeison Leandro Ortiz un amigo de la familia.

Sandra seduce y manipula a su joven amante Gyan Carlos, convenciéndolo de asesinar a su esposo Mauricio a cambio de amor y una vida juntos. Sin saberlo, Gyan Carlos no era el único hombre bajo su control. Tras el crimen, errores de novatos facilitaron la investigación, llevando tanto a Sandra como a su amante a pagar una larga condena en prisión.

En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

Michell, de 13 años, tuvo gemelos prematuros tras huir de Venezuela a Colombia. Sin recursos y con apoyo solo de su madre, lucha por la salud de sus bebés en hospitales de Cúcuta mientras enfrenta rechazo familiar. Su historia refleja la devastadora realidad del embarazo infantil en Latinoamérica, donde miles de niñas enfrentan riesgos de salud, pobreza y abandono cada año.

Gustavo Quintana, "el doctor muerte," falleció tras realizar más de 500 eutanasias a pacientes terminales que buscaban una muerte digna. Yolanda Chaparro, diagnosticada con ELA, luchó un año contra el sistema de salud para lograr su derecho a morir en paz. Horas antes de su eutanasia, Yolanda recibió una serenata de su familia, sonriendo pese a las circunstancias.

Elizabeth asegura que una vidente dijo que Nehemías no es el padre del bebé de Ja'Quasia, pero ella no cree en bolas de cristal. Además, Heidi y Tabbi afirman que AJ es el padre de sus hijos, ¡aunque AJ solo confía en Tabbi!

Tiara quiere que De'Ron admita que él es el padre de su bebé. Él afirma que la prueba está en los dedos: ¡el bebé de su prometida Diamond tiene dos meñiques como él! Más tarde, ¿Michelle tuvo un bebé con Shane, el cuñado de Mitchell?

Shenik y Shenequa aparecieron en el programa de Maury el año pasado después de una prueba de ADN. ¿Pero ahora Shenik se acuesta con el novio de su hermana? Además, lo único que se interpone para que estas parejas se casen son los resultados de la prueba del detector de mentiras.

Robert cree que su hija está siendo abusada y abusada sexualmente por su padrastro, John, pero John y Tiffany lo niegan. ¿Está Tiffany encubriendo el abuso de John? ¡Vea la impactante prueba del detector de mentiras hoy!

Tasked with saving the branch, Yong Ju is sent to recruit Min Ju, whom she recognises from a past encounter.
Yong Ju’s persistence begins to wear on Min Ju. Meanwhile, a town meeting is set to reveal shocking news.
Yong Ju refuses to exploit Min Ju despite the villagers’ hostility, while the beer festival falls into chaos.
Yong Ju's heroic act deeply moves Min Ju, and they uncover a rival’s cheating scheme and Ah Reum’s secret.
A change in business strategy disrupts their beer project, and Yong Ju suspects internal sabotage.
Min Ju falls for Yong Ju, but guilt over her grandmother’s condition drives him into isolation.
Yong Ju struggles with her feelings while Min Ju waits patiently. Jealousy surfaces when his ex appears.
Yong Ju grows closer to Min Ju as she grieves her grandmother, while an outsider returns with hidden motives.
Yong Ju and Min Ju's beer lineup fails internal evaluation, prompting them to push a bold revival plan.
Disputes over beer inconsistencies strain Yong Ju and Min Ju’s relationship, leading to escalating chaos.
Yong Ju tackles online sabotage and achieves sales success before contemplating her next step.
Wang Won, the crown prince of the Goryeo Dynasty, visits Lee Seung Hyu with his friend Wang Rin.
As it gets dark, Wang Won and Wang Rin spend a night in a cave with Eun San.
Wang Jeon asks permission of Eun Yeong Baek, the father of Eun San, to marry her.
Wang Won tries to find the one who shot an arrow at King Chung Ryeol to prove Wang Rin's innocence.
Due to Song In's trick, Eun San is caught as one of the attackers of the King's assassination.
Song In gets to know Eun San's identity and forces her to marry Wang Jeon.
While Wang Rin tries hard to mar Eun San's marriage talks, Wang Won senses the uneasy atmosphere.
King Chung Ryeol becomes furious when he hears that Wang Won interfered in Wang Jeon's marriage.
Wang Rin puts up himself to save his sister Wang Dan.
Princess Won Seong and Song In capture Eun Yeong Baek and Eun San, coveting their property.
To provide support, Princess Won Seong fetches Lee Seung Hyu for Wang Won.
Wang Won comes up against King Chung Ryeol to get back Eun San.
To stop Eun San from leaving, Wang Won reinvestigates the Sungjookjae incident.
Princess Won Seong orders Eun San to testify on the Sungjookjae incident to ruin Wang Rin's family.
Wang Rin wants to protect Eun San, who is devastated at her father's death.
Wang Rin and Eun San are chased by Jang Ui, Princess Won Seong's men, and King Chung Ryeol's men.
Wang Rin announces that he would marry Eun San but Wang Won detains Rin and brings San to his place.
Discovering the truth of Princess Won Seong's death, Wang Won loses his temper.
Wang Won gets to know Wang Rin's real intention and gains powerful political position with his help.
Wang Won, Wang Rin, and Eun San makes their own resolution to save Goryeo from Yuan.
Hong Deok Su and Prince Mu Yeong join Yongcheonru as apprentices, each with their own hidden motives.
Disguised as Lee Eun Ho, the prince keeps a close eye on Deok Su as he attempts to retrieve the golden key.
A murder involving a forged certificate raises tensions, while the quartet struggles to pass their exams.

Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name

Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.
The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.
After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.

John Thornton, is a fearless man who's after more than gold; he wants to do what's right. Thornton works for the U.S. mail and is the only person daring and smart enough to figure out how to travel the deadly 600 miles from Skagway to Dawson, Alaska in the icy winter. His incredibly dog Buck is by his side and part of how he survives.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who’s landed on her head in training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident.

Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen off a roof-top balcony. Dr Emma West calms a mum who’s cut though her hand.

Dr Tinnie Chang’s confused patient has severe head and back injuries after a horror fall. Nurse Lucy Stranger and Dr Zaheer Jayhoon fear the worst for a woman with heart issues. Dr Bec Hughes’ young patient has strange abdominal pain.
A rider is bucked off her horse and is lying helpless in remote bushland. A risky chopper rescue is her only chance, and Bill desperately tries to save a teacher having a massive heart attack.

Paramedics Laura and Aaron prepare for double the complications when a pregnant mum goes into labour. In a first for the show, cameras follow the patient into hospital not to save a life, but to welcome a new one.

Ben and Mim find a grandfather in agony with horrific burns after spilling a huge pot of boiling water over himself. Lisa’s first day back from maternity leave has her examining a tiny baby with a soaring heart rate and high temperature.

Aaron and Laura fear the worst as they rush to a teen victim of a shark bite. Ben and Mim must tackle a footy player who’s dislocated his shoulder and super mums, Sally and Olivia race to a terrified one year old with a severed finger.

Every second counts as paramedics rush to help people in crisis. A leaking oxygen bottle blows up in a man’s face. Nhi and Carlos fear he could stop breathing at any moment. Bill is on high alert, dealing with a violent knife fight.
Aaron and Laura desperately try to stop blood pouring from a pedestrian’s head after he was hit by a car and terrifying seizures threaten to leave a young Mum with permanent brain damage.

Aaron and Laura rush to a young mother who is bleeding heavily from cervical cancer and a bizarre case for Lisa as she is called to a patient whose obsession with hot chillies has now left him in excruciating pain
Ben and Mim are called to a patient in the final stages of labour. Newly qualified Ben has never delivered a baby and he’s hoping this will be his first. A dementia case hits home for Lisa.
A hero bystander uses CPR to bring a woman back from the dead but intensive care paramedic Bill needs to get the grandmother to hospital before she goes back into a fatal cardiac arrest.

Paramedics, Sally and Olivia fear the worst for a young motorcyclist in agonising pain after a terrifying accident and Laura and Aaron are impressed by the courage of a little boy who has suffered an horrendous fractured leg.

Dr Emma faces a dangerous situation with an aggressive stabbing victim. The patient will die without help, yet he’s putting up a fight. Dr Mark treats a factory worker in shock after being confronted with horrific life-changing injuries.

A gunshot victim arrives under police guard and Dr Sarah fears the patient could die from his injuries. Dr Jonathan treats a critical footy player after an on-field collision. Nurse Lucy worries a pregnant patient can’t feel her baby move.

Dr Mark tries to help a car crash patient under police guard, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse.

Dr Mark assembles a crack team to save a man with life-threatening gunshot wounds. Dr Jonathan suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career.

Dr Emma’s patient could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael on high alert. Dr Michelle stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

Security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto hospital staff. Dr Jonathan’s car crash patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt, but she’s more worried what her dad will say. Dr Mya’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed.

Dr Steve’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking accident at an abattoir. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn suspects another trigger. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana.

A life hangs in the balance as Dr Emma rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Dr Lauren treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff and is bleeding heavily from an open fracture.

Dr Miriam treats a heavily pregnant mum-to-be who collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Sarah fears for a cyclist who was hit by a car and can’t feel his feet.

Mark and Carina race to help a critically injured paraglider who’s crashed into a cliff. A creepy case of bed bugs makes Michelle nervous. Jamie and Mike struggle to convince a cyclist hit by a car that she needs to go to hospital.

Mark and Carina race to save a young woman struggling to breathe from a severe asthma attack. Matt airlifts a trauma patient to hospital after a horror car crash. Taz and Amanda find a fun way of deciding who drives the ambulance.

Nat and Leonard get a surprise while treating a suspected drug overdose. A heartbreaking fall for a 98-year-old woman requires a delicate rescue mission. And vicious abuse from a member of the public shocks Amanda and Taz.

Nat and Leonard battle to save an elderly woman after a suspected stroke. Taz and Amanda race to help a child trapped in a car outside a kindergarten. A missing item of clothing has Nicola and Michelle scratching their heads.

Matt treats a patient burnt in a work-place explosion, but bad weather jeopardises the flight to hospital. Nat presses Leonard to propose marriage. Mark struggles with a misbehaving driver who’s crashed into a pole.

Mark is called to a volatile emergency as a man leaps from a moving car and goes on a rampage. Flight paramedic Ray races to a camping trip SOS. Amanda and Leonard treat a badly injured tourist after an ill-fated skateboarding attempt.

Every second counts as paramedics try to reach an unconscious patient by breaking into her house. Mark and Carina treat a man with a life-threatening condition, where the only way to save him is to stop his heart.

A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled. Matt becomes concerned after a frightened car crash survivor loses her memory. Risky and Nicola are confronted by an unwanted intruder.

Mark races to help a young father in danger of losing his arm, following a horrific workplace accident. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction creating chaos, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation.

Royal Melbourne Emergency’s Dr Mya and Nurse Ebony brace themselves as paramedics bring in a man who’s been on a two-day drug bender. Dr Emma calls in back-up to save a mum who’s clinging to life after a high-speed crash.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, a teen jockey has been crushed under a horse, fracturing her pelvis. This potentially career-ending injury isn’t Dr Mya Cubitt’s biggest worry. Dr Scott Taylor uses a clever hack for removing rings from swollen fingers.

At Royal Melbourne emergency, an abattoir worker has cut her fingers off. Can Dr Bjorn Makein and nurse Sarah Thomas save her hand? Dr Thomas Razga puts a young mum with an earring mishap on laughing gas, with hilarious results.

A crane operator is crushed under falling steel at work and is flown to The Royal Melbourne. Dr Jonathan Papson calls in reinforcements as the young worker’s vital signs worsen. Dr Emma West treats an erratic pregnant woman.

At Royal Melbourne Emergency a paramedic becomes the patient after stepping on a deadly snake while jogging. Drs Michael Dunne and Jana Alexander treat a seriously injured grandmother who was thrown off a horse and trampled.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Sarah Whitelaw battles to save a teen driver with major head injuries after rolling his car. A trail bike rider crashes horribly, but impresses Dr Michelle Thornhill with his wit.

In Royal Melbourne Emergency, doctors rush to save a man bleeding internally after being thrown from a horse. A law student’s condition puzzles Dr Luke. Dr George has grave fears for a handy man who’s fallen six metres onto concrete.

In The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Michelle Thornhill and Martin Dutch have seconds to spare as a man struggles to breathe. Dr Jonathan Papson fixes up an old friend suffering severe bee stings from a backyard hive.

Every second counts at The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, as injured people pour in. Dr Luke treats an injured tradie hit by a falling tree. Later, he rejects a patient’s offer to mend a broken leg with icy pole sticks!

Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victim of a brutal assault. Ray and the Air Ambulance crew help an unlucky gardener with a bizarre and dangerous injury.

A shocking motorcycle accident leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall.

Matt attempts a difficult rescue of an injured paraglider. A horse trainer is critical after being kicked in the head. An aggressive patient at a train station puts Taz and Amanda to the test. A hit and run endangers a baby’s life.

A mother is badly injured in a car crash and is desperate to find her baby girl. A shop assistant mysteriously collapses. Will expectant parents meet their baby in the back of the ambulance before Mike or Eamon can get them to hospital?

Carina and Doddsy battle traffic to save a child. Taz and Amanda have a hair-raising encounter with a dog bite victim. Cullen responds to a devastating road accident. Glenice takes a coastal trek to reach the victim of a selfie gone wrong

Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case? Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. A laid back patient with a major problem has Leonard and Amanda on tenterhooks and Ray helps the victim of a high-speed car crash.

The last stage before the Grand Finals, and the pressure is on. With this level of carnage not all robots may leave the arena as they fight for the title, and their lives.
The Fourth Wars is coming to an end, beginning with two rounds of playoffs, where four will be whittled down to two. Of the remaining two, one will become Robot Wars: The Fourth Wars champions.
Four teams comprised of celebrities and veteran roboteers. Which celebrity has a natural flare for mechanical combat and who will be having words with their agent when they end up in the pit?
Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.
Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?
The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?
A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?
A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?
Poisonous gas is leaking from an abandoned mine. Can the Rescue Robots prevent the entire city being wiped out?
Rescue Robots face their toughest challenge yet as an Earthquake causes power cuts and landslides.
Lightning strikes have damaged the communication network of Calamity City, the team has to fix it to bring order back to the people.
An unexploded bomb of unknown origin threatens the safety of Calamity City, the Rescue Robots have to dispose of it sor risk destroying the whole city.
Two research droids have gone missing whilst investigating bizarre volcanic activity. Will the Rescue Robots find them in time?
Robot Wars returns. The House Robots have been upgraded and are ready to dismantle any of the 40 competing teams brave enough to enter the hazardous arena.
A Consultant Cardiologist and his two sons try their luck with a brand new, untested machine. Judge Sethu Vijayakumar discusses his work with Nasa in creating androids for the Mission to Mars.
This show features an eclectic collection of home-made robots, one designed by a nine year old and another constructed out of wood. Some competitors from the Classic series return to the arena.
In this show we see the former Holiday camp Bluecoats daring to flip two of the House Robots with their ‘launcher’ Apollo. The most expensive Robot in the Series competes in this Heat.
This features one of the most bizarre but certainly the tallest robot ever seen on Robot Wars, Gabriel, built my Mensa member Craig and his three sons.
In this show the heat winners in shows 1 to 5 come back to fight again. The judges must choose one Wild Card from the runners up to join them.

The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.
The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?
A hurricane has left the city in flames. Can the team extinguish the inferno before it’s too late?
Severe weather jeopardises vital research information, the Rescue Robots must navigate their way through a dangerous minefield to retrieve it.
A test plane has crash landed, the Rescue Robots are tasked with finding the cause of the crash, before the fuel tanks explode.
The Rescue Robots must disable rogue military robots before they wreak havoc on Calamity City.

An unidentified object from outer-space has crashed in the desert on the outskirts of Calamity City and is leaking radiation, the Rescue Robots must retrieve and contain the object before it causes harm to the city.

The first heat of the second Revival Series begins. Robots return from previous series to take on the daring newcomers and each other. Competitors get bullied and thrown around the ring as they desperately try to scrape a place in the finals.
A tentative start to the second heat ends in carnage as the house robots and competitors go all out to qualify. Shunt delivers the final blow for one contestant.

The third heat shows devastating weapons put into action, being on the receiving end of these could mean elimination for an unlucky competitor. The house robots take on cleaning duties as they remove immobilised robots from the arena floor.
One competitor draws first blood only seconds into the first round. After suffering severe damage at the hands of another competitor, one robots chance at the finals may be lost.
The last chance for combatants to fight for a place in the Grand Final. With the newcomers outnumbering the veterans, will the first timers make up for their lack of experience?

This episode, a new Robot Wars champion will emerge! Sparks and scraps are sure to fly in this explosive series finale. Winners will have to make it through the four-way melees and head-to-head battles to be able to prove themselves in the final.

The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

Six competitors, including World Champion Razer battle it out for a shot at the Fourth Wars title. Irreparable damage could mean the permanent end of one of the veteran competitors in the semi-finals.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.
Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.

KITT from "Knight Rider" pulls up to the Stash; a rare Green Arrow Mego figure and Archie Bunker's grandson.
Lindsay Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") stops in for a Silver Surfer item; Jem and Ghostbusters toys spark another round of banter.

Kevin and Harley visit for the Yoga Hosers premiere; Ming becomes a lead villain with help from a special-effects makeup legend.
Members of the 501st Legion of Stormtroopers invade the Stash looking for new recruits; the fate of a vintage Ewok playset.
Ralph Macchio seeks a rare "Karate Kid" playset; Ming gets an unforgettable lesson; Walt gets excited about a Mechagodzilla.
The guys prepare for a maritime adventure when the Batboat docks in Red Bank; Batman's first appearance.
Jason Mewes inserts himself into transactions involving a Deadshot statue and a vintage Death Star Space Station.
Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.
Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.
Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.
A Kreskin ESP game reveals Walt's powers of cognition; discussions about Mork from Ork and Dick Tracy's Rogues' Gallery.
Tom Cavanaugh visits the shop; Walt finds a Golden Age classic with "Human Torch No. 2."
Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.
Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.
The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.
Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.
Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.
Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.
Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."
Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.
Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.
Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.
When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."
Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.
Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.
Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.
Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.
Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.
Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.
Ming dares Walt, Bryan and Mike to get tattoos; one customer looks for romance while another makes a deal.
Walt and the guys throw a birthday party at the Stash; larger-than-life Darth Vader helmet.
The guys attend a local auction; bad results from mixing comic books and cigars.
The guys pursue the Jersey Devil; selling Thundercat figures.
When Walt and Mike fall ill, Ming must run Stash by himself; first issues of Iron Man and Daredevil.
Ming arranges for the Stash to join in on the local sidewalk sale; Walt sells some early "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" comics.
Mike and Ming participate in a 5K zombie run for Kevin's charity; Walt buys an unusual item.
Kevin visits the Stash for a book signing; Jay acts as security; a customer brings in original artwork.
The guys prepare for a visit from Stan Lee; Walt has a chance to buy a valuable comic book.
The Stash sells an independent comic book, so the guys can see a costumed MMA fight; Walt buys nostalgic underwear.
The guys want to make a sandwich that represents the Stash; a valuable comic.
Walt negotiates for an original Asteroids arcade cabinet; Ming is excited for GI Joes.

A customer tries to sell a gaming system with a twist; Ming buys another piece of his childhood.
The guys try to create their own comic book; Walt buys a signed issue of Creepy.
The guys play charades with a comic book twist; Walt has the chance to buy original artwork.
Ming plans a surprise for Walt's anniversary at The Stash; Ming learns the virtue of patience.
Lou Ferrigno gives Bryan a lesson on fitness; a customer wants to purchase a key comic by Frank Miller.
Walt and the guys are invited to an actual bat cave; a customer wants to sell his original Star Wars action figures.
The guys ask George Perez to help rebuild Mike's collection; vintage interactive comic books.
Ming has the chance to purchase an oversized toy from the '80s; taking a wife on the perfect date.
A fan sells a Mr. T backyard water game; Ming is inspired to have fun on a hot day; Walt risks the shop's street credibility.
The guys bid on derelict storage units in hopes of striking it rich; Walt finds a fellow Elfquest fanatic.
A fan of "The Dukes of Hazzard" stops by to show off his collection of memorabilia; Walt encounters his first "brony."
The guys travel to the Baltimore Comic Con to launch their comic book, "Cryptozoic Man"; Jeff works on a Saturday to fill in for Walt.
A customer buys a gift for his father's 75th birthday; the Stash throws a party for Superman's 75th birthday.
A woman is looking for an Uhura Mego doll from the '70s; an X-Men fan buys the first appearance of Phoenix.
Walt is inspired to form a bowling team; an ill-conceived action figure shows up.
Bored, Walt quizzes the guys on comic book trivia; a customer sells a Hellboy prop replica.
The Stash helps auction off the work of Mike Esposito; Walt buys a paper doll.
The guys have the opportunity to buy a replica of the '66 Batcycle; a collection of Marvel fan magazines from the '70s.
A young man wants to appraise his collection; Walt buys Wayne Gretzky memorabilia.
Jason Mewes invites the guys to a Renaissance fair; a customer brings in a valuable item.
Kevin Smith sends his daughter to The Stash to learn how to be a clerk; a customer wants to sell rare and unusual "Rocky" action figures.
A returning customer brings in a toy that Walt always coveted; an aspiring student brings in an autographed book.
Walt challenges the others to perform stand-up routines; a collector brings in Marvel Comics from the 1960s.
The guys agree to baby-sit a friend's daughter for the afternoon; an Indiana Jones superfan has items from the films.
Walt and the others attend BronyCon, a convention for "My Little Pony" fans; a customer wants to sell a Godzilla board game from the 1970s.
Walt considers buying the hand and footprints of Adam West and Burt Ward; a rare set of Star Wars comic strips.
The co-creator of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Kevin Eastman, brings in early sketches of the turtles.
Walt has a business proposition for original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson; a customer wants to sell cartoon shampoo bottles from the 1960s.
Adam West visits and a race between the Batmobile and Black Beauty ensues; a customer sells the first appearance of Rocket Raccoon.
Artist Neal Adams and writer Denny O'Neil visit the Stash; the guys see a set of 50-year-old Batman night lights.
Butch Patrick (Eddie Munster) stops by the Stash; a never officially released rare Star Wars action figure.
Kevin's assistant, Ashley, learns about comic book retail at the Stash; pro wrestlers want to sell their comic.
Darryl McDaniels of Run-DMC brings his new comic to the Stash; the guys look at a Marvel Silver Age number one issue.
Billy Dee Williams stops by the store to win the Millennium Falcon the same way Lando lost it: a high-stakes card game.
Jason Mewes hangs out and plays clerk at the Stash; Walt wants to acquire a mysterious recreation of comic book art.
The guys attend a KISS concert; Walt lives out his childhood dream of meeting Gene Simmons; Ming considers buying an arcade cabinet.
Peter Mayhew ("Chewbacca") judges a Wookiee contest at the Stash; one of the hottest comic books of the 1990s.
Mike flies in the Batcopter to celebrate fifteen years at the Secret Stash; the guys look at one of the hottest books of the '90s.
Kevin talks comics with actor William Shatner; Walt covets a Mego doll that has unique packaging.
The guys and Bryan visit a "Jaws" museum; super-powered toilet paper comes through.
The guys are prompted to reconsider their preparations for the apocalypse by a zombie comic; an eccentric collector wants Walt's help.
Stan Lee helps a customer who is experiencing a comics crisis; a customer buys a classic issue of Fantastic Four.
Secret Stash employees audition with Walt and Bryan for a role in the claymation film they are making with Brian Quinn.
Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.

Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in elevated plant-based French pastries, “pastrami” sammies, Thai “chicken” wings, and unbelievable “carne” asada.

Welcome to the magical world of dessert making. In a homage to the art of conjuring and illusion, our competitors must create magical desserts that melt, crack and lift away, to reveal an inner delight.

Today's episode showcases how chocolate can elevate our favourite desserts. As a filling to fluffy donuts, folded through a decadent creme brulee or as a coating to a crunchy peanut brittle, the options are endless.
Jamie Oliver makes crispy parma pork, minted zucchini, and brown rice; plus a grilled mushroom sub with smoky pancetta, melted cheese, and pears.
Little Cove Bakery in the tourist town of Tobermory, is languishing in the off-season. Owner Kelly has used up all her savings and will have to shut down if Steve can't turn her business around fast
Lyra and Abe need Steve's help to expand their limited menu, grow their customer base & stand out in a strip mall full of competition.
Jamie’s rustling up lamb meatballs, chop salad, and harissa yogurt; plus an incredibly delicious chicken salad.

Bakers from East Aurora, New York, Vancouver, Canada and Manchester, New Hampshire compete in a speedy eliminaJon round with Mayonnaise as the mystery ingredient.  The  last two standing compete for $10,000 in an Alien-­‐themed Cupcake Showdown. With  judges Zane Caplansky , Johnny Iuzzini and Sherry Yard.

The series is off to an energetic start as Diana delves into the vibrant and healthy flavours of Vietnamese cooking. With the expertise of her flatmate Khanh Ong cooking their favorite dishes together. Diana is also joined in the kitchen by  chef Jerry Mai who demonstrates how to make mini rice pancakes that are best served with freshly brewed Vietnamese beer, of course!

Thai food is on the menu so Diana enlists the help of mentor and Thai food enthusiast, Gary Mehigan, who is an expert at striking the balance of salty, sweet and sour. She also explores the varieties of fresh Asian herbs at the  market, before heading back to the kitchen to recreate a delicious dish she sampled on a recent trip.
The home cooks go global with crowd-pleasers from around the world, and kelp has everyone reeling when they take a deep dive into Chef Todd Perrin’s fridge.

Jamie kicks things off this week by cooking up his Super-Fast Sizzling Seared Scallops with a cool hack for speedy spuds. Then there’s egg and mango chutney flatbreads, a snack for when you’re in a hurry with the fastest bread you’ll ever make.

Silvia starts with the basics. How do Italian home cooks shop for pantry staples and fresh produce? A guided visit to an Italian deli leads to shopping and preparing of: a rustic Tuscan chickpea pasta, bakes 2 succulent and savoury Schiacciata breads and Silvia's mothers Apple and Mascarpone cake. Proving that when an Italian pantry is well stocked you only need a few fresh ingredients to create simple yet memorable meals
Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in elevated plant-based French pastries, “pastrami” sammies, Thai “chicken” wings, and unbelievable “carne” asada.

Welcome to the magical world of dessert making. In a homage to the art of conjuring and illusion, our competitors must create magical desserts that melt, crack and lift away, to reveal an inner delight.
Jamie's recipes feature crab bolognese and crunchy fennel salad, plus Mexican BLT, chilies, guacamole, and salad.
Jenn visits an organic grain farmer, a baker, and a whiskey maker to learn about the various uses of wheat.
Muffins are a staple for mornings and snack breaks, and their small portioning make them an easy treat.
Waffles are definitely a part of a baker’s repertoire and that woven waffles shape is now known the world around. Here we explore North American, Italian & Belgian styles of waffles.
A modern approach to a traditional Chinese crowd-pleaser has the Chefs intrigued, and the home cooks get salty when Herbes Salées is revealed in Chef Marysol Foucault’s Quebecois fridge.

Jamie’s cooking up sesame seared tuna, a mouthwatering meal in minutes, and messy meatball buns—feel-good family food that’s fast and loaded with flavor—followed by his irresistibly gooey Chocolate Rye Cookies, home baking at breakneck speed.

Family recipes are an eternal source of happiness for Italians, and in this episode Silvia shares her family’s - most cherished meals. A rich sausage stew on a  bed of soft polenta. A timeless family favourite, Pasta with Potato and - Provola. And direct from Italy via webcam, Silvia’ Mum helps her bake Abruzzese style waffles.

In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

At Helberg Barbecue in Waco, Jess discovers the magic of smoke-fried chicken, where low-and-slow meets hot oil for maximum flavour and crunch. Back home, she demystifies the process, showing how to achieve that signature smoky, crispy finish without complicated equipment.

Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.
Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.
Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?
Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!
We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?
This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.
